text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 为“使用”本条目所述设备而“专门设计”的“软件”见ECCN 3D201。(2) 为增强或释放变频器或发生器性能，使其达到或超过本条目所述性能水平而“专门设计”的“软件”见ECCN 3D202。(3) 本条目管制物项的“技术”见ECCN 3E001（“开发”和“生产”）及3E201（“使用”）。(4) 为分离铀同位素而“专门设计”或制备的变频器（亦称转换器或逆变器）由核管理委员会行使出口许可管理权限（见10 CFR第110部分）。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCN 3D201 for “software” “specially designed” for the “use” of equipment described in this entry. (2) See ECCN 3D202 for “software” “specially designed” to enhance or release the performance characteristics of frequency changers or generators to meet or exceed the level of the performance characteristics described in this entry. (3) See ECCNs 3E001 (“development” and “production”) and 3E201 (“use”) for “technology” for items controlled under this entry. (4) Frequency changers (a.k.a. converters or inverters) “specially designed” or prepared for use in separating uranium isotopes are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

text.zh: 相关定义：不适用
text.en: Related Definitions: N/A

text.zh: 物项：a. 多相输出功率为40 VA或以上；
text.en: Items: a. Multiphase output providing a power of 40 VA or greater;

text.zh: b. 工作频率为600 Hz或以上；以及
text.en: b. Operating at a frequency of 600 Hz or more; and

text.zh: c. 频率控制优于（小于）0.2%。
text.en: c. Frequency control better (less) than 0.2%.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Notes:

text.zh: 1. 本ECCN仅在用于特定工业机械和/或消费品（机床、车辆等）的变频器从该机械和/或商品中取出后仍能达到本条目所述性能特性时，对其实施管制。本注不将本条目所述、构成不受管制物项主要要素且实际上可拆卸或用于其他用途的变频器排除在本条目的管制之外。
text.en: 1. This ECCN controls frequency changers intended for use in specific industrial machinery and/or consumer goods (machine tools, vehicles, etc.) only if the frequency changers can meet the performance characteristics described in this entry when removed from the machinery and/or goods. This Note does not exclude from control under this entry any frequency changer described herein that is the principal element of a non-controlled item and can feasibly be removed or used for other purposes.

text.zh: 2. 判定某一变频器是否达到或超过本条目所述性能特性时，必须同时考虑硬件和“软件”的性能限制。
text.en: 2. To determine whether a particular frequency changer meets or exceeds the performance characteristics described in this entry, both hardware and “software” performance constraints must be considered.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 本ECCN管制的变频器亦称转换器或逆变器。
text.en: 1. Frequency changers controlled by this ECCN are also known as converters or inverters.

text.zh: 2. 以下名称销售的某些设备也可能满足本ECCN所述性能特性：发生器、电子测试设备、交流电源、变速电动机驱动器、变速驱动器（VSD）、变频驱动器（VFD）、可调频率驱动器（AFD）或可调速度驱动器（ASD）。
text.en: 2. The performance characteristics described in this ECCN also may be met by certain equipment marketed as: Generators, electronic test equipment, AC power supplies, variable speed motor drives, variable speed drives (VSDs), variable frequency drives (VFDs), adjustable frequency drives (AFDs), or adjustable speed drives (ASDs).

text.zh: 物项：a. 工作原理类似火花隙、无论是否充气且同时具有以下所有特性的冷阴极管：
text.en: Items: a. Cold-cathode tubes, whether gas filled or not, operating similarly to a spark gap, having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: a.1. 含有三个或更多电极；
text.en: a.1. Containing three or more electrodes;

text.zh: a.2. 额定阳极峰值电压为2.5 kV或以上；
text.en: a.2. Anode peak voltage rating of 2.5 kV or more;

text.zh: a.3. 额定阳极峰值电流为100 A或以上；以及
text.en: a.3. Anode peak current rating of 100 A or more; and

text.zh: a.4. 阳极延迟时间为10 µs或以下。
text.en: a.4. Anode delay time of 10 µs or less.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 3A228.a包括充气氪管和真空触发管。
text.en: 3A228.a includes gas krytron tubes and vacuum sprytron tubes.

text.zh: b. 同时具有以下两项特性的触发火花隙：
text.en: b. Triggered spark-gaps having both of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.1. 阳极延迟时间为15 µs或以下；以及
text.en: b.1. An anode delay time of 15 µs or less; and

text.zh: b.2. 额定峰值电流为500 A或以上。
text.en: b.2. Rated for a peak current of 500 A or more.

text.zh: c. 具有快速开关功能且同时具有以下所有特性的模块或组件：

text.zh: c.1. 额定阳极峰值电压大于2 kV；

text.zh: c.2. 额定阳极峰值电流为500 A或以上；以及
text.en: c.2. Anode peak current rating of 500 A or more; and

text.zh: c.3. 导通时间为1 µs或以下。
text.en: c.3. Turn-on time of 1 µs or less.

text.zh: 物项：

text.zh: a. 为驱动多个3A232管制的受控雷管而设计的雷管起爆装置（起爆系统、点火装置），包括电子充能、爆炸驱动和光驱动起爆装置；
text.en: a. Detonator firing sets (initiation systems, firesets), including electronically-charged, explosively-driven and optically-driven firing sets designed to drive multiple controlled detonators controlled by 3A232;

text.zh: b. 同时具有以下所有特性的模块化电脉冲发生器（脉冲器）：
text.en: b. Modular electrical pulse generators (pulsers) having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.1. 为便携、移动或加固用途设计；
text.en: b.1. Designed for portable, mobile, or ruggedized use;

text.zh: b.2. 能在小于15 µs内向小于40 Ω（欧姆）的负载释放其能量；
text.en: b.2. Capable of delivering their energy in less than 15 µs into loads of less than 40 Ω (ohms);

text.zh: b.3. 输出电流大于100 A；
text.en: b.3. Having an output greater than 100 A;

text.zh: b.4. 任何尺寸均不大于30 cm；
text.en: b.4. No dimension greater than 30 cm;

text.zh: b.5. 重量小于30 kg；以及

text.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCNs 3E001 (“development” and “production”) and 3E201 (“use”) for technology for items controlled under this entry. (2) Mass spectrometers “specially designed” or prepared for analyzing on-line samples of UF_{6} gas streams are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 电感耦合等离子体质谱仪（ICP/MS）；
text.en: a. Inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometers (ICP/MS);

text.zh: b. 辉光放电质谱仪（GDMS）；
text.en: b. Glow discharge mass spectrometers (GDMS);

text.zh: c. 热电离质谱仪（TIMS）；
text.en: c. Thermal ionization mass spectrometers (TIMS);

text.zh: d. 同时具有以下两项特征的电子轰击质谱仪：
text.en: d. Electron bombardment mass spectrometers having both of the following features:

text.zh: d.1. 分子束进样系统，将准直的待分析分子束注入离子源中由电子束使分子电离的区域；以及
text.en: d.1. A molecular beam inlet system that injects a collimated beam of analyte molecules into a region of the ion source where the molecules are ionized by an electron beam; and

text.zh: d.2. 一个或多个可冷却至193 K（−80 °C）或以下的冷阱，以捕集未被电子束电离的待分析分子；
text.en: d.2. One or more cold traps that can be cooled to a temperature of 193 K (−80 °C) or less in order to trap analyte molecules that are not ionized by the electron beam;

text.zh: e. 配有为锕系元素或其氟化物设计的微量氟化离子源的质谱仪。
text.en: e. Mass spectrometers equipped with a microfluorination ion source designed for actinides or actinide fluorides.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. ECCN 3A233.d管制通常用于UF_{6}气体样品同位素分析的质谱仪。
text.en: 1. ECCN 3A233.d controls mass spectrometers that are typically used for isotopic analysis of UF_{6} gas samples.

text.zh: 2. ECCN 3A233.d中的电子轰击质谱仪亦称电子碰撞质谱仪或电子电离质谱仪。
text.en: 2. Electron bombardment mass spectrometers in ECCN 3A233.d are also known as electron impact mass spectrometers or electron ionization mass spectrometers.

text.zh: 3. 在ECCN 3A233.d.2中，“冷阱”是通过将气体分子在冷表面上冷凝或冻结而加以捕集的装置。在本ECCN中，闭环气态氦低温真空泵不属于冷阱。
text.en: 3. In ECCN 3A233.d.2, a “cold trap” is a device that traps gas molecules by condensing or freezing them on cold surfaces. For the purposes of this ECCN, a closed-loop gaseous helium cryogenic vacuum pump is not a cold trap.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) USML第XI类或其他USML类别列明的电子物项，以及与之直接相关的技术数据（包括软件），受ITAR管辖。(2) 为受ITAR管辖的国防物品编程的专用集成电路（ASIC）和可编程逻辑器件（PLD）由USML第XI(c)(1)类管制。(3) 未编程的可编程逻辑器件（PLD）的管制见ECCN 3A001.a.7。(4) 布局为国防物品“专门设计”的印刷电路板和已装配电路卡由USML第XI(c)(2)类管制。(5) 图形或布局为国防物品“专门设计”的多芯片模块由USML第XI(c)(3)类管制。(6) 为军用“专门设计”、未在任何USML类别中受控但属于其他“600系列”ECCN或9x515 ECCN范围的电子物项，由该“600系列”ECCN或9x515 ECCN管制。例如，未列于USML或3A611以外某个“600系列”条目、为USML第VIII类或ECCN 9A610管制的军用航空器“专门设计”的电子部件，由ECCN 9A610.x的兜底条款管制。未列于USML或其他“600系列”条目、为USML第VII类或ECCN 0A606管制的军用车辆“专门设计”的电子部件，由ECCN 0A606.x管制。未列于USML、为USML第IV类管制的导弹“专门设计”的电子部件，由ECCN 9A604管制。(7) 某些抗辐射微电子电路如为国防物品、“600系列”物项或9A515管制物项“专门设计”，则由ECCN 9A515.d或9A515.e管制。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) Electronic items that are enumerated in USML Category XI or other USML categories, and technical data (including software) directly related thereto, are subject to the ITAR. (2) Application specific integrated circuits (ASICs) and programmable logic devices (PLD) that are programmed for defense articles that are subject to the ITAR are controlled in USML Category XI(c)(1). (3) See ECCN 3A001.a.7 for controls on unprogrammed programmable logic devices (PLD). (4) Printed circuit boards and populated circuit cards with a layout that is “specially designed” for defense articles are controlled in USML Category XI(c)(2). (5) Multichip modules for which the pattern or layout is “specially designed” for defense articles are controlled in USML Category XI(c)(3). (6) Electronic items “specially designed” for military application that are not controlled in any USML category but are within the scope of another “600 series” ECCN or a 9x515 ECCN are controlled by that “600 series” ECCN or 9x515 ECCN. For example, electronic components not enumerated on the USML or a “600 series” other than 3A611 that are “specially designed” for a military aircraft controlled by USML Category VIII or ECCN 9A610 are controlled by the catch-all control in ECCN 9A610.x. Electronic components not enumerated on the USML or another “600 series” entry that are “specially designed” for a military vehicle controlled by USML Category VII or ECCN 0A606 are controlled by ECCN 0A606.x. Electronic components not enumerated on the USML that are “specially designed” for a missile controlled by USML Category IV are controlled by ECCN 9A604.(7) Certain radiation-hardened microelectronic circuits are controlled by ECCN 9A515.d or 9A515.e, when “specially designed” for defense articles, “600 series” items, or items controlled by 9A515.

text.en: Related Definitions: N/A

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 为军用“专门设计”，且未在任何USML类别或其他“600系列”ECCN中列明或以其他方式描述的电子“设备”、“最终产品”和“系统”。
text.en: a. Electronic “equipment,” “end items,” and “systems” “specially designed” for a military application that are not enumerated or otherwise described in either a USML category or another “600 series” ECCN.
Note to 3A611.a:

text.zh: ECCN 3A611.a包括为军用“专门设计”、未在任何USML类别中列明或以其他方式描述、也未由其他“600系列”ECCN管制的任何雷达、电信、声学或计算机设备、最终产品或系统。
text.en: ECCN 3A611.a includes any radar, telecommunications, acoustic or computer equipment, end items, or systems “specially designed” for military application that are not enumerated or otherwise described in any USML category or controlled by another “600 series” ECCN.

text.zh: b.-d. [保留]
text.en: b.-d. [Reserved]

text.zh: e. 高频（HF）地波雷达，通过接收的雷达信号持续保持对所关注海面或低空目标的位置状态跟踪。
text.en: e. High frequency (HF) surface wave radar that maintains the positional state of maritime surface or low altitude airborne objects of interest in a received radar signal through time.
Note to 3A611.e:

text.zh: ECCN 3A611.e不适用于为海上交通管制“专门设计”的系统、设备和组件。
text.en: ECCN 3A611.e does not apply to systems, equipment, and assemblies “specially designed” for marine traffic control.

text.zh: f. 不受本条目.y段管制、且为“600系列”物项编程的专用集成电路（ASIC）和可编程逻辑器件（PLD）。
text.en: f. Application specific integrated circuits (ASICs) and programmable logic devices (PLD) that are not controlled by paragraph .y of this entry and that are programmed for “600 series” items.

text.zh: .f段注：
text.en: Note to paragraph .f:

text.zh: 本段中，“专用集成电路”是指为特定用途或功能开发和生产的集成电路，无论该集成电路为多少客户开发或生产。
text.en: In this paragraph, the term 'application specific integrated circuit' means an integrated circuit developed and produced for a specific application or function regardless of number of customers for which the integrated circuit is developed or produced.

text.zh: g. 不受本条目.y段管制、且布局为“600系列”物项“专门设计”的印刷电路板和已装配电路卡组件。
text.en: g. Printed circuit boards and populated circuit card assemblies that are not controlled by paragraph .y of this entry and for which the layout is “specially designed” for “600 series” items.

text.zh: h. 不受本条目.y段管制、且图形或布局为“600系列”物项“专门设计”的多芯片模块。
text.en: h. Multichip modules that are not controlled by paragraph .y of this entry and for which the pattern or layout is “specially designed” for “600 series” items.

text.zh: i.至w. [保留]
text.en: i. through w. [Reserved]

text.zh: x. 为本条目管制的商品或USML第XI类管制的物品“专门设计”，且未在任何USML类别、其他600系列ECCN的.x段以外任何段落或本条目.y段中列明或描述的“零件”、“部件”、“附件”和“附属装置”。
text.en: x. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” that are “specially designed” for a commodity controlled by this entry or for an article controlled by USML Category XI, and not enumerated or described in any USML category or in any paragraph other than the .x paragraph of another 600 series ECCN or in paragraph .y of this entry.

text.zh: ECCN 3A611.x注1：
text.en: Note 1 to ECCN 3A611.x:

text.zh: ECCN 3A611.x包括为军用“专门设计”的雷达、电信、声学系统或设备或计算机而“专门设计”的“零件”、“部件”、“附件”和“附属装置”，且这些物项既不受任何USML类别管制，也不受其他“600系列”ECCN的.x段以外任何段落管制。
text.en: ECCN 3A611.x includes “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for a radar, telecommunications, acoustic system or equipment or computer “specially designed” for military application that are neither controlled in any USML category nor controlled in any paragraph other than the .x paragraph of another “600 series” ECCN.

text.zh: ECCN 3A611.x注2：
text.en: Note 2 to ECCN 3A611.x:

text.zh: ECCN 3A611.x管制为USML第XI(c)(12)类管制、含有单晶铌镁酸铅-钛酸铅（PMN-PT）基压电材料的水下传感器或发射器“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”。
text.en: ECCN 3A611.x controls “parts” and “components” “specially designed” for underwater sensors or projectors controlled by USML Category XI(c)(12) containing single-crystal lead magnesium niobate lead titanate (PMN-PT) based piezoelectrics.

text.zh: ECCN 3A611.x注3：
text.en: Note 3 to ECCN 3A611.x:

text.zh: 受EAR管辖并属于任何600系列.x条目范围的“零件”、“部件”、“附件”和“附属装置”，如果其类型用于或可能用于多个平台（例如军用电子设备、军用车辆和军用航空器），或与这些平台配合使用，可归入3A611.x。
text.en: “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” subject to the EAR and within the scope of any 600 series .x entry that are of a type that are or would potentially be for use in or with multiple platforms (e.g., military electronics, military vehicles, and military aircraft) may be classified under 3A611.x.

text.zh: ECCN 3A611注：
text.en: Note to ECCN 3A611:

text.zh: 运用“专门设计”定义判定印刷电路板、已装配电路卡组件或多芯片模块是否受本条目.g、.h、.y.15或.y.16段管制时，电路板或组件的布局以及模块的图形和布局，是根据“专门设计”定义唯一需要评估的特征。
text.en: When applying the “specially designed” definition to determine whether a printed circuit board, populated circuit card assembly or multichip module is controlled by paragraph .g, .h, .y.15 or .y.16 of this entry, the layout of the board or assembly and the pattern and layout of the module are the only characteristics that need be evaluated under the “specially designed” definition.

text.zh: a. 未在3A001.a.2中列明、设计在等于或低于（优于）4.5 K（−268.65 °C）环境温度下工作的互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）集成电路。
text.en: a. Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) integrated circuits, not specified by 3A001.a.2, designed to operate at an ambient temperature equal to or less (better) than 4.5 K (−268.65 °C).

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 在3A901.a中，CMOS集成电路亦称低温CMOS或cryo-CMOS。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A901.a, CMOS integrated circuits are also referred to as cryogenic CMOS or cryo-CMOS.

text.zh: b. 同时具有以下所有特性的参量信号放大器：
text.en: b. Parametric signal amplifiers having all of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 设计在低于1 K（−272.15 °C）的环境温度下工作；
text.en: b.1. Designed for operation at an ambient temperature below 1 K (−272.15 °C);

text.zh: b.2. 设计在2 GHz至15 GHz（含15 GHz）范围内任一频率下工作；以及
text.en: b.2. Designed for operation at any frequency from 2 GHz up to and including 15 GHz; and

text.zh: b.3. 在1 K（−272.15 °C）下，在2 GHz至15 GHz（含15 GHz）范围内任一频率的噪声系数小于（优于）0.015 dB。
text.en: b.3. A noise figure less (better) than 0.015 dB at any frequency from 2 GHz up to and including 15 GHz at 1 K (−272.15 °C).

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 在3A901.b中，参量信号放大器包括行波参量放大器（TWPA）。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A901.b, parametric signal amplifiers include Travelling Wave Parametric Amplifiers (TWPAs).

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 在3A901.b中，参量信号放大器亦可称为量子极限放大器（QLA）。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A901.b, parametric signal amplifiers may also be referred to as Quantum-limited amplifiers (QLAs).

text.zh: b. 额定能够维持低于4 K（−269.15 °C）的温度，并在4.2 K（−268.95 °C）或以下温度下提供大于或等于1.5 W制冷功率的两级脉冲管低温冷却器。
text.en: b. Two-stage pulse tube cryocoolers rated to maintain a temperature below 4 K (−269.15 °C) and provide a cooling power greater than or equal to 1.5 W at or below a temperature of 4.2 K (−268.95 °C).

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 具有以下任一特性的“微处理器微电路”、“微计算机微电路”和微控制器微电路：
text.en: a. “Microprocessor microcircuits”, “microcomputer microcircuits”, and microcontroller microcircuits having any of the following:

text.zh: a.1. 运算速度为5 GFLOPS或以上，且算术逻辑单元访问宽度为32位或以上；
text.en: a.1. A performance speed of 5 GFLOPS or more and an arithmetic logic unit with an access width of 32 bit or more;

text.zh: a.2. 时钟频率超过25 MHz；或
text.en: a.2. A clock frequency rate exceeding 25 MHz; or

text.zh: a.3. 具有一个以上的数据总线、指令总线或串行通信端口，以2.5 Mbyte/s传输速率为并行“微处理器微电路”之间提供直接外部互连；
text.en: a.3. More than one data or instruction bus or serial communication port that provides a direct external interconnection between parallel “microprocessor microcircuits” with a transfer rate of 2.5 Mbyte/s;

text.zh: b. 下列存储集成电路：
text.en: b. Storage integrated circuits, as follows:

text.zh: b.1. 电可擦可编程只读存储器（EEPROM），其存储容量：
text.en: b.1. Electrical erasable programmable read-only memories (EEPROMs) with a storage capacity;

text.zh: b.1.a. 对闪存类型而言，每个封装超过16 Mbit；或
text.en: b.1.a. Exceeding 16 Mbits per package for flash memory types; or

text.zh: b.1.b. 对其他所有EEPROM类型而言，超过以下任一限值：
text.en: b.1.b. Exceeding either of the following limits for all other EEPROM types:

text.zh: b.1.b.1. 每个封装超过1 Mbit；或
text.en: b.1.b.1. Exceeding 1 Mbit per package; or

text.zh: b.1.b.2. 每个封装超过256 kbit，且最大访问时间小于80 ns；
text.en: b.1.b.2. Exceeding 256 kbit per package and a maximum access time of less than 80 ns;

text.zh: b.2. 静态随机存取存储器（SRAM），其存储容量：
text.en: b.2. Static random access memories (SRAMs) with a storage capacity:

text.zh: b.2.a. 每个封装超过1 Mbit；或
text.en: b.2.a. Exceeding 1 Mbit per package; or

text.zh: b.2.b. 每个封装超过256 kbit，且最大访问时间小于25 ns；
text.en: b.2.b. Exceeding 256 kbit per package and a maximum access time of less than 25 ns;

text.zh: c. 具有以下任一特性的模数转换器：
text.en: c. Analog-to-digital converters having any of the following:

text.zh: c.1. 分辨率为8位或以上但低于12位，且输出速率大于每秒2亿字；
text.en: c.1. A resolution of 8 bit or more, but less than 12 bit, with an output rate greater than 200 million words per second;

text.zh: c.2. 分辨率为12位，且输出速率大于每秒1.05亿字；
text.en: c.2. A resolution of 12 bit with an output rate greater than 105 million words per second;

text.zh: c.3. 分辨率超过12位但等于或低于14位，且输出速率大于每秒1,000万字；或
text.en: c.3. A resolution of more than 12 bit but equal to or less than 14 bit with an output rate greater than 10 million words per second; or

text.zh: c.4. 分辨率超过14位，且输出速率大于每秒250万字；
text.en: c.4. A resolution of more than 14 bit with an output rate greater than 2.5 million words per second;

text.zh: d. 单端数字输入/输出最大数量在200至700之间的现场可编程逻辑器件；
text.en: d. Field programmable logic devices having a maximum number of single-ended digital input/outputs between 200 and 700;

text.zh: e. 1,024点复数FFT的额定执行时间小于1 ms的快速傅里叶变换（FFT）处理器；
text.en: e. Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) processors having a rated execution time for a 1,024 point complex FFT of less than 1 ms;

text.zh: f. 制造商不知道其功能，或不知道将使用该集成电路的设备的管制状态，且具有以下任一特性的定制集成电路：
text.en: f. Custom integrated circuits for which either the function is unknown, or the control status of the equipment in which the integrated circuits will be used is unknown to the manufacturer, having any of the following:

text.zh: f.1. 超过144个端子；或
text.en: f.1. More than 144 terminals; or

text.zh: f.2. 典型“基本传输延迟时间”小于0.4 ns；
text.en: f.2. A typical “basic propagation delay time” of less than 0.4 ns;

text.zh: g. 下列脉冲或连续波行波“真空电子器件”：
text.en: g. Traveling-wave “vacuum electronic devices,” pulsed or continuous wave, as follows:

text.zh: g.1. 耦合腔器件或其衍生器件；
text.en: g.1. Coupled cavity devices, or derivatives thereof;

text.zh: g.2. 基于螺旋线、折叠波导或蛇形波导电路的螺旋线器件或其衍生器件，具有以下任一特性：
text.en: g.2. Helix devices based on helix, folded waveguide, or serpentine waveguide circuits, or derivatives thereof, with any of the following:

text.zh: g.2.a. “瞬时带宽”为半个倍频程或以上；以及
text.en: g.2.a. An “instantaneous bandwidth” of half an octave or more; and

text.zh: g.2.b. 额定平均输出功率（以kW表示）与最高工作频率（以GHz表示）的乘积大于0.2；
text.en: g.2.b. The product of the rated average output power (expressed in kW) and the maximum operating frequency (expressed in GHz) of more than 0.2;

text.zh: g.2.c. “瞬时带宽”小于半个倍频程；以及
text.en: g.2.c. An “instantaneous bandwidth” of less than half an octave; and

text.zh: g.2.d. 额定平均输出功率（以kW表示）与最高工作频率（以GHz表示）的乘积大于0.4；
text.en: g.2.d. The product of the rated average output power (expressed in kW) and the maximum operating frequency (expressed in GHz) of more than 0.4;

text.zh: h. 设计用于超过40 GHz频率的柔性波导；
text.en: h. Flexible waveguides designed for use at frequencies exceeding 40 GHz;

text.zh: i. 具有以下任一特性的声表面波和表面掠射（浅体）声波器件（即利用材料中弹性波的“信号处理”器件）：
text.en: i. Surface acoustic wave and surface skimming (shallow bulk) acoustic wave devices (i.e., “signal processing” devices employing elastic waves in materials), having either of the following:

text.zh: i.1. 载波频率超过1 GHz；或
text.en: i.1. A carrier frequency exceeding 1 GHz; or

text.zh: i.2. 载波频率为1 GHz或以下；以及
text.en: i.2. A carrier frequency of 1 GHz or less; and

text.zh: i.2.a. 频率旁瓣抑制超过55 Db；
text.en: i.2.a. A frequency side-lobe rejection exceeding 55 Db;

text.zh: i.2.b. 最大延迟时间与带宽的乘积大于100（时间以微秒计，带宽以MHz计）；或
text.en: i.2.b. A product of the maximum delay time and bandwidth (time in microseconds and bandwidth in MHz) of more than 100; or

text.zh: i.2.c. 色散延迟超过10微秒；
text.en: i.2.c. A dispersive delay of more than 10 microseconds;

text.zh: j. 下列电芯：
text.en: j. Cells as follows:

text.zh: j.1. 在293 K（20 °C）下能量密度为550 Wh/kg或以下的一次电芯；
text.en: j.1. Primary cells having an energy density of 550 Wh/kg or less at 293 K (20 °C);

text.zh: j.2. 在293 K（20 °C）下能量密度为350 Wh/kg或以下的二次电芯；
text.en: j.2. Secondary cells having an energy density of 350 Wh/kg or less at 293 K (20 °C);

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A991.j不管制电池，包括单电芯电池。
text.en: 3A991.j does not control batteries, including single cell batteries.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 在3A991.j中，能量密度（Wh/kg）按标称电压乘以标称安时容量再除以以千克计的质量计算。如果未注明标称容量，则能量密度按标称电压的平方乘以以小时计的放电时长，再除以以欧姆计的放电负载和以千克计的质量计算。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 3A991.j energy density (Wh/kg) is calculated from the nominal voltage multiplied by the nominal capacity in ampere-hours divided by the mass in kilograms. If the nominal capacity is not stated, energy density is calculated from the nominal voltage squared then multiplied by the discharge duration in hours divided by the discharge load in Ohms and the mass in kilograms.

text.zh: 2. 在3A991.j中，“电芯”定义为具有正负电极及电解质并作为电能来源的电化学装置。它是电池的基本构成单元。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 3A991.j, a 'cell' is defined as an electrochemical device, which has positive and negative electrodes, and electrolyte, and is a source of electrical energy. It is the basic building block of a battery.

text.zh: 3. 在3A991.j.1中，“一次电芯”是设计为不能通过任何其他来源充电的“电芯”。
text.en: 3. For the purposes of 3A991.j.1, a 'primary cell' is a 'cell' that is not designed to be charged by any other source.

text.zh: 4. 在3A991.j.2中，“二次电芯”是设计为可通过外部电源充电的“电芯”。
text.en: 4. For the purposes of 3A991.j.2, a 'secondary cell' is a 'cell' that is designed to be charged by an external electrical source.

text.zh: k. 为在不到一分钟内完全充电或放电而“专门设计”，并同时具有以下所有特性的“超导”电磁铁或螺线管：
text.en: k. “Superconductive” electromagnets or solenoids “specially designed” to be fully charged or discharged in less than one minute, having all of the following:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A991.k不管制为磁共振成像（MRI）医疗设备设计的“超导”电磁铁或螺线管。
text.en: 3A991.k does not control “superconductive” electromagnets or solenoids designed for Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) medical equipment.

text.zh: k.1. 放电期间释放的最大能量除以放电持续时间，大于每分钟500 kJ；
text.en: k.1. Maximum energy delivered during the discharge divided by the duration of the discharge of more than 500 kJ per minute;

text.zh: k.2. 载流绕组的内径大于250 mm；以及
text.en: k.2. Inner diameter of the current carrying windings of more than 250 mm; and

text.zh: k.3. 额定磁感应强度大于8T，或绕组“总电流密度”大于300 A/mm^{2}；
text.en: k.3. Rated for a magnetic induction of more than 8T or “overall current density” in the winding of more than 300 A/mm^{2};

text.zh: l. 用于电磁储能的电路或系统，含有由“超导”材料制造、为在低于其至少一种“超导”组分“临界温度”的温度下运行而“专门设计”的“部件”，并同时具有以下所有特性：
text.en: l. Circuits or systems for electromagnetic energy storage, containing “components” manufactured from “superconductive” materials “specially designed” for operation at temperatures below the “critical temperature” of at least one of their “superconductive” constituents, having all of the following:

text.zh: l.1. 谐振工作频率超过1 MHz；
text.en: l.1. Resonant operating frequencies exceeding 1 MHz;

text.zh: l.2. 储存能量密度为1 MJ/M^{3}或以上；以及
text.en: l.2. A stored energy density of 1 MJ/M^{3} or more; and

text.zh: l.3. 放电时间小于1 ms；
text.en: l.3. A discharge time of less than 1 ms;

text.zh: m. 陶瓷金属结构且额定峰值电流为500 A或以上的氢/氢同位素闸流管；
text.en: m. Hydrogen/hydrogen-isotope thyratrons of ceramic-metal construction and rate for a peak current of 500 A or more;

text.zh: n. 基于任何化合物半导体、等效门数超过300（2输入门）的数字集成电路；
text.en: n. Digital integrated circuits based on any compound semiconductor having an equivalent gate count of more than 300 (2 input gates);

text.zh: o. “适用于航天”且不受3A001.e.4管制的太阳能电池、电池-互连-盖玻片（CIC）组件、太阳能电池板和太阳能电池阵列；
text.en: o. Solar cells, cell-interconnect-coverglass (CIC) assemblies, solar panels, and solar arrays, which are “space qualified” and not controlled by 3A001.e.4;

text.zh: p. 未另行列明且具有以下任一特性的集成电路：
text.en: p. Integrated circuits, n.e.s., having any of the following:

text.zh: p.1. 处理性能为8 TOPS或以上；或
text.en: p.1. A processing performance of 8 TOPS or more; or

text.zh: p.2. 通过所有输入和输出，与易失性存储器以外的集成电路之间进行传入或传出的总双向传输速率为150 Gbyte/s或以上。
text.en: p.2. An aggregate bidirectional transfer rate over all inputs and outputs of 150 Gbyte/s or more to or from integrated circuits other than volatile memories.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 在3A991.p中：
text.en: For the purposes of 3A991.p:

text.zh: 1. 本ECCN包括但不限于中央处理单元（CPU）、图形处理单元（GPU）、张量处理单元（TPU）、神经处理器、存内处理器、视觉处理器、文本处理器、协处理器/加速器、自适应处理器和现场可编程逻辑器件（FPLD）。
text.en: 1. This ECCN includes but is not limited to central processing units (CPU), graphics processing units (GPU), tensor processing units (TPU), neural processors, in-memory processors, vision processors, text processors, co-processors/accelerators, adaptive processors, and field-programmable logic devices (FPLDs).

text.zh: 2. TOPS指每秒万亿次运算，即每秒10^{12}次运算。
text.en: 2. TOPS is Tera Operations Per Second or 10^{12} Operations per Second.

text.zh: 3. 在3A991.p中，TOPS为2 × “MacTOPS”，并对集成电路上的所有处理单元求和。
text.en: 3. For purposes of 3A991.p, TOPS is 2 × 'MacTOPS' aggregated over all processing units on the integrated circuit.

text.zh: a. 在3A991.p中，“MacTOPS”是乘累加运算（D = A × B + C）每秒万亿（10^12）次运算的理论峰值。
text.en: a. For purposes of 3A991.p, 'MacTOPS' is the theoretical peak number of Tera (10^12) operations per second for multiply-accumulate computation (D = A × B + C).

text.zh: b. 公式中的2基于行业惯例：在数据表中，将一次乘累加运算D = A × B + C计为2次运算。因此，2 × “MacTOPS”可对应于数据表报告的TOPS或FLOPS。
text.en: b. The 2 in the formula is based on industry convention of counting one multiply-accumulate computation, D = A × B + C, as 2 operations for purpose of datasheets. Therefore, 2 × 'MacTOPS' may correspond to the reported TOPS or FLOPS on a datasheet.

text.zh: 3B001.a.1包括原子层外延（ALE）设备。
text.en: 3B001.a.1 includes atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) equipment.

text.zh: a.2. 为含有铝、镓、铟、砷、磷、锑、氧或氮中两种及以上元素的材料进行化合物半导体外延生长而设计的金属有机化学气相沉积（MOCVD）反应器；
text.en: a.2. Metal Organic Chemical Vapor Deposition (MOCVD) reactors designed for compound semiconductor epitaxial growth of material having two or more of the following elements: aluminum, gallium, indium, arsenic, phosphorus, antimony, oxygen, or nitrogen;

text.zh: a.3. 使用气态或固态源的分子束外延生长设备；
text.en: a.3. Molecular beam epitaxial growth equipment using gas or solid sources;

text.zh: a.4. 为硅（Si）或锗硅（SiGe）外延生长而设计，且具有以下全部特性的设备：
text.en: a.4. Equipment designed for epitaxial growth of silicon (Si) or silicon germanium (SiGe), and having all of the following:

text.zh: a.4.a. 至少一个为提供晶圆表面清洗的表面预处理手段而设计的预清洗腔室；以及
text.en: a.4.a. At least one preclean chamber designed to provide a surface preparation means to clean the surface of the wafer; and

text.zh: a.4.b. 为在小于等于958 K（685 °C）的温度下工作而设计的外延沉积腔室。
text.en: a.4.b. An epitaxial deposition chamber designed to operate at a temperature equal to or below 958 K (685 °C).

text.zh: b. 为离子注入而设计，且具有下列任一特性的半导体晶圆制造设备：
text.en: b. Semiconductor wafer fabrication equipment designed for ion implantation and having any of the following:
b.1. [Reserved]

text.zh: b.2. 为氢、氘或氦注入而设计和优化，可在大于等于20 keV的束能量和大于等于10 mA的束电流下工作；
text.en: b.2. Being designed and optimized to operate at a beam energy of 20 keV or more and a beam current of 10 mA or more for hydrogen, deuterium, or helium implant;

text.zh: b.3. 具有直写能力；
text.en: b.3. Direct write capability;

text.zh: b.4. 用于向加热的半导体材料“衬底”进行高能氧注入，束能量大于等于65 keV且束电流大于等于45 mA；或
text.en: b.4. A beam energy of 65 keV or more and a beam current of 45 mA or more for high energy oxygen implant into a heated semiconductor material “substrate”; or

text.zh: b.5. 为向加热至大于等于600 °C的半导体材料“衬底”进行硅注入而设计和优化，可在大于等于20 keV的束能量和大于等于10mA的束电流下工作；
text.en: b.5. Being designed and optimized to operate at beam energy of 20 keV or more and a beam current of 10mA or more for silicon implant into a semiconductor material “substrate” heated to 600 °C or greater;

text.zh: c. 刻蚀设备。
text.en: c. Etch equipment.

text.zh: c.1. 下列为干法刻蚀而设计的设备：
text.en: c.1. Equipment designed for dry etching as follows:

text.zh: c.1.a. 为各向同性干法刻蚀而设计或改装，且最大‘锗硅对硅（SiGe:Si）刻蚀选择比’大于等于100:1的设备；或
text.en: c.1.a. Equipment designed or modified for isotropic dry etching, having a largest 'silicon germanium-to-silicon (SiGe:Si) etch selectivity' of greater than or equal to 100:1; or

text.zh: c.1.b.［保留］
text.en: c.1.b. [Reserved]

text.zh: c.1.c. 为各向异性干法刻蚀而设计或改装，且具有以下全部特性的设备；
text.en: c.1.c. Equipment designed or modified for anisotropic dry etching, having all of the following;

text.zh: c.1.c.1. 射频（RF）功率源，具有至少一个脉冲射频输出；
text.en: c.1.c.1. Radio Frequency (RF) power source(s) with at least one pulsed RF output;

text.zh: c.1.c.2. 一个或多个切换时间小于300毫秒的快速气体切换阀；以及
text.en: c.1.c.2. One or more fast gas switching valve(s) with switching time less than 300 milliseconds; and

text.zh: c.1.c.3. 具有二十个及以上可独立控制变温元件的静电卡盘；
text.en: c.1.c.3. Electrostatic chuck with twenty or more individually controllable variable temperature elements;

text.zh: c.2. 为湿法化学处理而设计，且最大‘锗硅对硅（SiGe:Si）刻蚀选择比’大于等于100:1的设备；
text.en: c.2. Equipment designed for wet chemical processing and having a largest 'silicon germanium-to-silicon (SiGe:Si) etch selectivity' of greater than or equal to 100:1;

text.zh: c.3. 为各向异性干法刻蚀而设计，且具有以下全部特性的设备：
text.en: c.3. Equipment designed for anisotropic dry etching having all of following:

text.zh: c.3.a 两个或更多独立射频源；
text.en: c.3.a Two or more RF independent sources;

text.zh: c.3.b 两个或更多独立气体源；
text.en: c.3.b Two or more independent gas sources;

text.zh: c.3.c 用于补偿晶圆厚度变化的‘工艺均匀性调节’；以及
text.en: c.3.c 'Process uniformity tuning' for wafer thickness variation compensation; and

text.zh: c.3.d 硅通孔（TSV）露出终点检测（EPD）；
text.en: c.3.d Through Silicon Via (TSV) reveal Endpoint Detection (EPD);

text.zh: c.4. 为硅通孔（TSV）刻蚀而设计，且具有以下全部特性的设备：
text.en: c.4. Equipment designed for Through Silicon Via (TSV) etch having all of the following:

text.zh: c.4.a. 硅刻蚀速率大于每分钟7微米；
text.en: c.4.a. Silicon etch rate greater than 7 microns per minute;

text.zh: c.4.b. 片内（WIW）刻蚀深度不均匀性小于等于2%；以及
text.en: c.4.b. Within wafer (WIW) etch depth non-uniformity of less than or equal 2 percent; and

text.zh: c.4.c. 硅通孔（TSV）深宽比大于等于10:1。
text.en: c.4.c. A Through Silicon Via (TSV) aspect ratio greater than or equal to 10:1.
Note 1:

text.zh: 3B001.c包括通过‘自由基’、离子、顺序反应或非顺序反应进行的刻蚀。
text.en: 3B001.c includes etching by 'radicals', ions, sequential reactions, or non-sequential reaction.
Note 2:

text.zh: 3B001.c.1.c包括采用射频脉冲激发等离子体、脉冲占空比激发等离子体、电极脉冲电压调制等离子体、结合等离子体的气体循环注入与吹扫、等离子体原子层刻蚀或等离子体准原子层刻蚀的刻蚀工艺。
text.en: 3B001.c.1.c includes etching using RF pulse excited plasma, pulsed duty cycle excited plasma, pulsed voltage on electrodes modified plasma, cyclic injection and purging of gases combined with a plasma, plasma atomic layer etching, or plasma quasi-atomic layer etching.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就3B001.c而言，‘锗硅对硅（SiGe:Si）刻蚀选择比’在Ge浓度大于等于30%（Si_{0.70}Ge_{0.30}）时测量。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 3B001.c, 'silicon germanium-to-silicon (SiGe:Si) etch selectivity' is measured for a Ge concentration of greater than or equal to 30% (Si_{0.70}Ge_{0.30}).

text.zh: 2. 就3B001.c注释1及3B001.d.14而言，‘自由基’定义为在开放电子壳层构型中具有未成对电子的原子、分子或离子。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 3B001.c Note 1 and 3B001.d.14, 'radical' is defined as an atom, molecule, or ion that has an unpaired electron in an open electron shell configuration.

text.zh: 3. 就3B001.c.3而言，‘工艺均匀性调节’是指补偿研磨后送入晶圆厚度变化的过程。
text.en: 3. For the purposes of 3B001.c.3, 'process uniformity tuning' is the process of compensating for incoming wafer thickness variations after grinding.

text.zh: d. 下列半导体制造沉积设备：
text.en: d. Semiconductor manufacturing deposition equipment, as follows:

text.zh: d.1. 为钴（Co）电镀或钴化学镀沉积工艺而设计的设备；
text.en: d.1. Equipment designed for cobalt (Co) electroplating or cobalt electroless-plating deposition processes;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B001.d.1管制半导体晶圆加工设备。
text.en: 3B001.d.1 controls semiconductor wafer processing equipment.

text.zh: d.2. 为下列工艺而设计的设备：
text.en: d.2. Equipment designed for:

text.zh: d.2.a. 钴（Co）填充金属的化学气相沉积；或
text.en: d.2.a. Chemical vapor deposition of cobalt (Co) fill metal; or

text.zh: d.2.b. 钨（W）填充金属的选择性自下而上化学气相沉积；
text.en: d.2.b. Selective bottom-up chemical vapor deposition of tungsten (W) fill metal;

text.zh: d.3. 为在单个腔室内通过执行下列全部多步工艺制造金属接触而设计的半导体制造设备：
text.en: d.3. Semiconductor manufacturing equipment designed to fabricate a metal contact by multistep processing within a single chamber by performing all of the following:

text.zh: d.3.a. 使用有机金属化合物沉积钨层，同时将晶圆衬底温度维持在大于100 °C且小于500 °C；以及
text.en: d.3.a. Deposition of a tungsten layer, using an organometallic compound, while maintaining the wafer substrate temperature greater than 100 °C and less than 500 °C; and

text.zh: d.3.b. 使用氢（H2）、氢和氮（H2+N2）或氨（NH3）的等离子体表面处理工艺。
text.en: d.3.b. Surface treatment plasma process using hydrogen (H2), hydrogen and nitrogen (H2+N2), or ammonia (NH3).

text.zh: d.4. 下列为在多个腔室或工位内进行多步加工而设计的设备或系统：
text.en: d.4. Equipment or systems designed for multistep processing in multiple chambers or stations, as follows:

text.zh: d.4.a. 为通过执行下列全部工艺制造金属接触而设计的设备：
text.en: d.4.a. Equipment designed to fabricate a metal contact by performing all of the following processes:

text.zh: d.4.a.1. 使用氢（H_{2}），包括氢和氮（H_{2} + N_{2}）或氨（NH_{3}）的等离子体表面处理工艺，同时将晶圆衬底温度维持在大于100 °C且小于500 °C；
text.en: d.4.a.1. Surface treatment plasma process using hydrogen (H_{2}), including hydrogen and nitrogen (H_{2} + N_{2}) or ammonia (NH_{3}), while maintaining the wafer substrate at a temperature greater than 100 °C and less than 500 °C;

text.zh: d.4.a.2. 使用氧（O_{2}）或臭氧（O_{3}）的等离子体表面处理工艺，同时将晶圆衬底温度维持在大于40 °C且小于500 °C；以及
text.en: d.4.a.2. Surface treatment plasma process using oxygen (O_{2}) or ozone (O_{3}), while maintaining the wafer substrate at a temperature greater than 40 °C and less than 500 °C; and

text.zh: d.4.a.3. 沉积钨（W）层，同时将晶圆衬底温度维持在大于100 °C且小于500 °C；
text.en: d.4.a.3. Deposition of a tungsten (W) layer while maintaining the wafer substrate temperature greater than 100 °C and less than 500 °C;

text.zh: d.4.b. 为通过执行下列全部工艺制造金属接触而设计的设备：
text.en: d.4.b. Equipment designed to fabricate a metal contact by performing all of the following processes:

text.zh: d.4.b.1 使用远程等离子体发生器和离子过滤器的表面处理工艺；以及
text.en: d.4.b.1 Surface treatment process using a remote plasma generator and an ion filter; and

text.zh: d.4.b.2. 使用有机金属化合物在铜（Cu）上选择性沉积钴（Co）层；
text.en: d.4.b.2. Deposition of a cobalt (Co) layer selectively onto copper (Cu) using an organometallic compound;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 本项管制不适用于非选择性设备。
text.en: This control does not apply to equipment that is non-selective.

text.zh: d.4.c. 为通过执行下列全部工艺制造金属接触而设计的设备：
text.en: d.4.c. Equipment designed to fabricate a metal contact by performing all the following processes:

text.zh: d.4.c.1. 使用有机金属化合物沉积氮化钛（TiN）或碳化钨（WC）层，同时将晶圆衬底温度维持在大于20 °C且小于500 °C；
text.en: d.4.c.1. Deposition of a titanium nitride (TiN) or tungsten carbide (WC) layer, using an organometallic compound, while maintaining the wafer substrate at a temperature greater than 20 °C and less than 500 °C;

text.zh: d.4.c.2. 使用物理溅射沉积技术沉积钴（Co）层，工艺压力大于133.3 mPa且小于13.33 Pa，同时将晶圆衬底温度维持在低于500 °C；以及
text.en: d.4.c.2. Deposition of a cobalt (Co) layer using a physical sputter deposition technique and having a process pressure greater than 133.3 mPa and less than 13.33 Pa, while maintaining the wafer substrate at a temperature below 500 °C; and

text.zh: d.4.c.3. 使用有机金属化合物沉积钴（Co）层，工艺压力大于133.3 Pa且小于13.33 kPa，同时将晶圆衬底温度维持在大于20 °C且小于500 °C；
text.en: d.4.c.3. Deposition of a cobalt (Co) layer using an organometallic compound and having a process pressure greater than 133.3 Pa and less than 13.33 kPa, while maintaining the wafer substrate at a temperature greater than 20 °C and less than 500 °C;

text.zh: d.4.d. 为通过执行下列全部工艺制造铜（Cu）互连而设计的设备：
text.en: d.4.d. Equipment designed to fabricate copper (Cu) interconnects by performing all of the following processes:

text.zh: d.4.d.1. 使用有机金属化合物沉积钴（Co）或钌（Ru）层，工艺压力大于133.3 Pa且小于13.33 kPa，同时将晶圆衬底温度维持在大于20 °C且小于500 °C；以及
text.en: d.4.d.1. Deposition of a cobalt (Co) or ruthenium (Ru) layer using an organometallic compound and having a process pressure greater than 133.3 Pa and less than 13.33 kPa, while maintaining the wafer substrate at a temperature greater than 20 °C and less than 500 °C; and

text.zh: d.4.d.2. 使用物理气相沉积技术沉积铜层，工艺压力大于133.3 mPa且小于13.33 Pa，同时将晶圆衬底温度维持在低于500 °C；
text.en: d.4.d.2. Deposition of a copper layer using a physical vapor deposition technique and having a process pressure greater than 133.3 mPa and less than 13.33 Pa, while maintaining the wafer substrate at a temperature below 500 °C;

text.zh: d.5. 为通过等离子体增强化学气相沉积形成厚度超过2 um且密度大于1.7g/cc的碳硬掩模而设计的设备；
text.en: d.5. Equipment designed for plasma enhanced chemical vapor deposition of carbon hard masks more than 2 um thick and with density of greater than 1.7g/cc;

text.zh: d.6. 为使用有机金属化合物进行阻挡层或衬层的区域选择性沉积而设计的原子层沉积（ALD）设备；
text.en: d.6. Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) equipment designed for area selective deposition of a barrier or liner using an organometallic compound;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B001.d.6包括能够区域选择性沉积阻挡层的设备，使填充金属与下方电导体形成接触，同时填充金属通孔与下方电导体的界面不存在阻挡层。
text.en: 3B001.d.6 includes equipment capable of area selective deposition of a barrier layer to enable fill metal contact to an underlying electrical conductor without a barrier layer at the fill metal via interface to an underlying electrical conductor.

text.zh: d.7. 为通过钨（W）的原子层沉积（ALD）填满整个互连或宽度小于40 nm的沟道，同时将晶圆衬底温度维持在低于500 °C而设计的设备。
text.en: d.7. Equipment designed for Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) of tungsten (W) to fill an entire interconnect or in a channel less than 40 nm wide, while maintaining the wafer substrate at a temperature less than 500 °C.

text.zh: d.8. 为‘功函数金属’的原子层沉积（ALD）而设计，且具有以下全部特性的设备：
text.en: d.8. Equipment designed for Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) of 'work function metal' having all of the following:

text.zh: d.8.a. 具有一个以上金属源，其中一个为铝（Al）前体而设计；
text.en: d.8.a. More than one metal source of which one is designed for an aluminum (Al) precursor;

text.zh: d.8.b. 前体容器的设计和功能配置可在大于30 °C的温度下工作；以及
text.en: d.8.b. Precursor vessel designed and enabled to operate at a temperature greater than 30 °C; and

text.zh: d.8.c. 为沉积‘功函数金属’而设计，且具有以下全部特性：
text.en: d.8.c. Designed for depositing a 'work function metal' having all of the following:

text.zh: d.8.c.1. 沉积碳化钛铝（TiAlC）；以及
text.en: d.8.c.1. Deposition of titanium-aluminum carbide (TiAlC); and

text.zh: d.8.c.2. 可实现大于4.0 eV的功函数；
text.en: d.8.c.2. Enabling a work function greater than 4.0 eV;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3B001.d.8而言，‘功函数金属’是控制晶体管阈值电压的材料。
text.en: For the purposes of 3B001.d.8, 'work function metal' is a material that controls the threshold voltage of a transistor.

text.zh: d.9. 具有绕轴旋转的晶圆支撑平台，且具有下列任一特性的空间原子层沉积（ALD）设备：
text.en: d.9. Spatial Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) equipment having a wafer support platform that rotates around an axis having any of the following:

text.zh: d.9.a. 空间等离子体增强原子层沉积工作模式；
text.en: d.9.a. A spatial plasma enhanced atomic layer deposition mode of operation;

text.zh: d.9.b. 等离子体源；或
text.en: d.9.b. A plasma source; or

text.zh: d.9.c. 等离子体屏蔽装置或将等离子体限制在等离子体暴露工艺区域内的手段；
text.en: d.9.c. A plasma shield or means to confine the plasma to the plasma exposure process region;

text.zh: d.10. 为通过等离子体增强原子层沉积（ALD）或化学气相沉积（CVD）形成低氟钨（FW）薄膜（氟（F）浓度小于10^{19}原子/cm^{3}）而设计的设备；
text.en: d.10. Equipment designed for Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) or Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) of plasma enhanced of low fluorine tungsten (FW) (fluorine (F) concentration less than 10^{19} atoms/cm^{3}) films;
d.11. [Reserved]

text.zh: d.12. 为沉积金属层而设计，且具有下列任一特性的设备：
text.en: d.12. Equipment designed for depositing a metal layer, and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.12.a. 无阻挡层的选择性钨（W）生长；或
text.en: d.12.a. Selective tungsten (W) growth without a barrier; or

text.zh: d.12.b. 无阻挡层的选择性钼（Mo）生长；
text.en: d.12.b. Selective molybdenum (Mo) growth without a barrier;

text.zh: d.13. 为使用有机金属化合物沉积钌（Ru）层，同时将晶圆衬底温度维持在大于20 °C且小于500 °C而设计的设备；
text.en: d.13. Equipment designed for depositing a ruthenium layer (Ru) using an organometallic compound, while maintaining the wafer substrate at a temperature greater than 20 °C and less than 500 °C;

text.zh: d.14. 为借助远程生成的‘自由基’进行沉积而设计、能够制造含硅（Si）和碳（C）薄膜，且沉积薄膜具有以下全部特性的设备：
text.en: d.14. Equipment designed for deposition assisted by remotely generated 'radicals', enabling the fabrication of a silicon (Si) and carbon (C) containing film, and having all of the following properties of the deposited film:

text.zh: d.14.a. 介电常数（k）小于4.4；
text.en: d.14.a. A dielectric constant (k) of less than 4.4;

text.zh: d.14.b. 位于深宽比大于5:1且横向开口小于35 nm的结构中；以及
text.en: d.14.b. In features with an aspect ratio greater than 5:1 with lateral openings of less than 35 nm; and

text.zh: d.14.c. 结构间节距小于45 nm；
text.en: d.14.c. A feature-to-feature pitch of less than 45 nm;

text.zh: d.15. 为在小于25 nm且深宽比大于等于1:1的金属线间隙中，以等离子体增强方式无空隙沉积介电常数小于3.3的低k介电层而设计的设备；
text.en: d.15. Equipment designed for void free plasma enhanced deposition of a low-k dielectric layer in gaps between metal lines less than 25 nm and having an aspect ratio greater than or equal to 1:1 with a less than 3.3 dielectric constant;
d.16. [Reserved]

text.zh: d.17. 为在单一平台上进行介电薄膜的等离子体增强化学气相沉积（PECVD）或自由基辅助化学气相沉积及紫外固化，同时将衬底温度维持在低于500 °C而设计，且该薄膜具有以下全部特性的设备：
text.en: d.17. Equipment designed for plasma enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD) or radical assisted chemical vapor deposition and UV curing in a single platform of a dielectric film, while maintaining a substrate temperature below 500 °C, having all of the following:

text.zh: d.17.a. 在节距小于24 nm且深宽比大于等于1:1.8的金属结构上，厚度大于6 nm且小于20 nm；以及
text.en: d.17.a. A thickness of more than 6 nm and less than 20 nm on metal features having less than 24 nm pitch and having an aspect ratio equal to or greater than 1:1.8; and

text.zh: d.17.b. 介电常数小于3.0；
text.en: d.17.b. A dielectric constant less than 3.0;

text.zh: d.18. 为钼（Mo）、钌（Ru）或Mo或Ru组合的原子层沉积（ALD）而设计或改装，且具有以下全部特性的设备：
text.en: d.18. Equipment designed or modified for Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) of molybdenum (Mo), ruthenium (Ru), or combinations Mo or Ru, and having all of the following:

text.zh: d.18.a. 为在大于75 °C的温度下工作而设计或改装的金属前体源；以及
text.en: d.18.a. A metal precursor source designed or modified to operate at a temperature greater 75 °C; and

text.zh: d.18.b. 在大于等于30 Torr（4 kPa）的压力下使用含氢（H）还原剂的工艺腔室（模块）。
text.en: d.18.b. A process chamber (module) using a reducing agent containing hydrogen (H) at a pressure greater than or equal to 30 Torr (4 kPa).

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 就d.18.a款而言，金属前体源无需与设备集成。金属前体可由设备上的源或厂房下层辅助区的源输送。
text.en: For the purposes of paragraph d.18.a, the metal precursor source need not be integrated with the equipment. The metal precursor could be delivered by an on-tool source or from a sub-fab source.

text.zh: d.19. 具有两种以上金属前体直接液体注入功能，为在单个沉积腔室内的深宽比大于200:1的结构中沉积介电常数（K）大于40的共形介电薄膜而设计或改装的沉积设备。
text.en: d.19. Deposition equipment having direct-liquid injection of more than two metal precursors, designed or modified to deposit a conformal dielectric film with a dielectric constant (K) greater than 40 in features with aspect ratio greater than 200:1 in a single deposition chamber.

text.zh: d.20. 具有用于引导离子通量的电磁体，且为将金属钨（W）沉积到深宽比大于等于3:1的结构中而“专门设计”的物理气相沉积设备。
text.en: d.20. Physical vapor deposition equipment having electromagnets for ion flux guidance, and “specially designed” to deposit tungsten (W) metal into features having an aspect ratio of 3:1 or greater.

text.zh: e. 具有以下全部特性的自动装载多腔室中央晶圆搬运系统：
text.en: e. Automatic loading multi-chamber central wafer handling systems having all of the following:

text.zh: e.1. 具有晶圆输入和输出接口，设计可连接两个以上功能不同、受3B001.a、.b、.c和.d管制的‘半导体工艺设备’；以及
text.en: e.1. Interfaces for wafer input and output, to which more than two functionally different 'semiconductor process tools' controlled by 3B001.a, .b., .c, and .d are designed to be connected; and

text.zh: e.2. 为在真空环境中形成集成系统以进行‘顺序多晶圆加工’而设计；
text.en: e.2. Designed to form an integrated system in a vacuum environment for 'sequential multiple wafer processing';

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B001.e不管制为并行晶圆加工而“专门设计”的自动机械手晶圆搬运系统。
text.en: 3B001.e does not control automatic robotic wafer handling systems “specially designed” for parallel wafer processing.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就3B001.e而言，‘半导体工艺设备’是指为半导体“生产”提供沉积、注入或热处理等不同功能物理工艺的模块化设备。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 3B001.e, 'semiconductor process tools' refers to modular tools that provide physical processes for semiconductor “production” that are functionally different, such as deposition, implant or thermal processing.

text.zh: 2. 就3B001.e而言，‘顺序多晶圆加工’是指在不同‘半导体工艺设备’中加工每片晶圆的能力，例如通过自动装载多腔室中央晶圆搬运系统，将每片晶圆从一个设备转移至第二个设备，再转移至第三个设备。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 3B001.e, 'sequential multiple wafer processing' means the capability to process each wafer in different 'semiconductor process tools', such as by transferring each wafer from one tool to a second tool and on to a third tool with the automatic loading multi-chamber central wafer handling systems.

text.zh: f. 下列光刻商品：
text.en: f. Lithography commodities as follows:

text.zh: f.1. 采用光学或X射线方法进行晶圆加工，且具有下列任一特性的步进重复式（晶圆直接步进式）或步进扫描式（扫描器）对准和曝光设备：
text.en: f.1. Align and expose step and repeat (direct step on wafer) or step and scan (scanner) equipment for wafer processing using photo-optical or X-ray methods and having any of the following:

text.zh: f.1.a. 光源波长短于193 nm；或
text.en: f.1.a. A light source wavelength shorter than 193 nm; or

text.zh: f.1.b. 光源波长大于等于193 nm，且具有以下全部特性：
text.en: f.1.b. A light source wavelength equal to or longer than 193 nm and having all of the following:

text.zh: f.1.b.1. 能够产生“最小可分辨特征尺寸”（MRF）小于等于45 nm的图形；以及
text.en: f.1.b.1. The capability to produce a pattern with a “Minimum Resolvable Feature size” (MRF) of 45 nm or less; and

text.zh: f.1.b.2. 最大‘专用卡盘套刻’值小于等于1.50 nm；
text.en: f.1.b.2. A maximum 'dedicated chuck overlay' value of less than or equal to 1.50 nm;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 就3B001.f.1.b而言：
text.en: For the purposes of 3B001.f.1.b:

text.zh: 1. ‘最小可分辨特征尺寸’（MRF）（即分辨率）按下式计算：
text.en: 1. The 'Minimum Resolvable Feature size' (MRF) (i.e., resolution) is calculated by the following formula:

text.zh: [公式图片：https://img.federalregister.gov/ER16JA25.003/ER16JA25.003_large.png]
text.en: [FORMULA IMAGE: https://img.federalregister.gov/ER16JA25.003/ER16JA25.003_large.png]

text.zh: 其中，就3B001.f.1.b而言，K因子=0.25；‘MRF’也称分辨率。
text.en: where, for the purposes of 3B001.f.1.b, the K factor = 0.25 'MRF' is also known as resolution.

text.zh: 2. ‘专用卡盘套刻’是指新图形与同一光刻系统已在晶圆上印制图形之间的对准精度。‘专用卡盘套刻’也称单机套刻。
text.en: 2. 'Dedicated chuck overlay' is the alignment accuracy of a new pattern to an existing pattern printed on a wafer by the same lithographic system. 'Dedicated chuck overlay' is also known as single machine overlay.

text.zh: f.2. 能够生产小于等于45 nm特征的压印光刻设备；
text.en: f.2. Imprint lithography equipment capable of production features of 45 nm or less;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:
3B001.f.2 includes:

text.zh: —微接触印刷设备
text.en: —Micro contact printing tools

text.zh: —热压印设备
text.en: —Hot embossing tools

text.zh: —纳米压印光刻设备
text.en: —Nano-imprint lithography tools

text.zh: —步进闪光压印光刻（S-FIL）设备
text.en: —Step and flash imprint lithography (S-FIL) tools

text.zh: f.3. 为制造掩模而“专门设计”，且具有以下全部特性的设备：
text.en: f.3. Equipment “specially designed” for mask making having all of the following:

text.zh: f.3.a. 偏转聚焦电子束、离子束或“激光”束；以及
text.en: f.3.a. A deflected focused electron beam, ion beam or “laser” beam; and

text.zh: f.3.b. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: f.3.b. Having any of the following:

text.zh: f.3.b.1. 半高全宽（FWHM）光斑尺寸小于65 nm，且图像定位误差小于17 nm（平均值+3 sigma）；或
text.en: f.3.b.1. A Full-Width Half-Maximum (FWHM) spot size smaller than 65 nm and an image placement less than 17 nm (mean + 3 sigma); or
f.3.b.2. [Reserved]

text.zh: f.3.b.3. 掩模上第二层套刻误差小于23 nm（平均值+3 sigma）；
text.en: f.3.b.3. A second-layer overlay error of less than 23 nm (mean + 3 sigma) on the mask;

text.zh: f.4. 为采用直写方法加工器件而设计，且具有以下全部特性的设备：
text.en: f.4. Equipment designed for device processing using direct writing methods, having all of the following:

text.zh: f.4.a. 偏转聚焦电子束；以及
text.en: f.4.a. A deflected focused electron beam; and

text.zh: f.4.b. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: f.4.b. Having any of the following:

text.zh: f.4.b.1. 最小束斑尺寸小于等于15 nm；或
text.en: f.4.b.1. A minimum beam size equal to or smaller than 15 nm; or

text.zh: f.4.b.2. 套刻误差小于27 nm（平均值+3 sigma）；
text.en: f.4.b.2. An overlay error less than 27 nm (mean + 3 sigma);

text.zh: f.5. 套刻精度小于（优于）1.5的压印光刻设备；
text.en: f.5. Imprint lithography equipment having an overlay accuracy less (better) than 1.5;

text.zh: f.6. 未由3B001.f.1列明，为在深紫外浸没式光刻设备中或与其配合执行以下全部功能而设计或改装的商品：
text.en: f.6. Commodities not specified by 3B001.f.1, designed or modified to perform all of the following in or with deep-ultraviolet immersion photolithography equipment:

text.zh: f.6.a. 降低3B001.f.1.b列明的最小可分辨特征尺寸；以及
text.en: f.6.a. Decrease the minimum resolvable feature specified by 3B001.f.1.b; and

text.zh: f.6.b. 将深紫外浸没式光刻设备的最大‘专用卡盘套刻’降低至小于等于1.5 nm。
text.en: f.6.b. Decrease the maximum 'dedicated chuck overlay' of a deep-ultraviolet immersion lithography tool below or equal to 1.5 nm.

text.zh: g. 为3A001管制集成电路而设计的掩模和光刻版；
text.en: g. Masks and reticles, designed for integrated circuits controlled by 3A001;

text.zh: h. 未由3B001.g列明、具有相移层且为光源波长小于245 nm的光刻设备而设计的多层掩模；
text.en: h. Multi-layer masks with a phase shift layer not specified by 3B001.g and designed to be used by lithography equipment having a light source wavelength less than 245 nm;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B001.h不管制具有相移层且为制造不受3A001管制的存储器件而设计的多层掩模。
text.en: 3B001.h does not control multi-layer masks with a phase shift layer designed for the fabrication of memory devices not controlled by 3A001.

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 为光学传感器“专门设计”的掩模和光刻版，见6B002。
text.en: For masks and reticles, “specially designed” for optical sensors, see 6B002.

text.zh: i. 为3A001所涉集成电路而设计的压印光刻模板；
text.en: i. Imprint lithography templates designed for integrated circuits by 3A001;

text.zh: j. 具有由钼和硅构成的多层反射结构，且具有以下全部特性的掩模“基板空白片”：
text.en: j. Mask “substrate blanks” with multilayer reflector structure consisting of molybdenum and silicon, and having all of the following:

text.zh: j.1. 为“极紫外”（“EUV”）光刻而“专门设计”；以及
text.en: j.1. “Specially designed” for “Extreme Ultraviolet” (“EUV”) lithography; and

text.zh: j.2. 符合SEMI P37标准；
text.en: j.2. Compliant with SEMI Standard P37;

text.zh: k. 为通过离子束沉积或物理气相沉积制造“EUV”掩模多层反射器而设计的设备；
text.en: k. Equipment designed for ion beam deposition or physical vapor deposition of a multi-layer reflector for “EUV” masks;

text.zh: l. “EUV”防尘膜；
text.en: l. “EUV” pellicles;

text.zh: m. 用于制造“EUV”防尘膜的设备；
text.en: m. Equipment for manufacturing “EUV” pellicles;

text.zh: n. 为涂覆、沉积、烘烤或显影专为“EUV”光刻配制的光刻胶而设计的设备；
text.en: n. Equipment designed for coating, depositing, baking, or developing photoresist formulated for “EUV” lithography;

text.zh: o.［保留］
text.en: o. [Reserved]

text.zh: p. 下列去除和清洗设备：
text.en: p. Removal and cleaning equipment as follows:
p.1. [Reserved]

text.zh: p.2. 具有表面改性干燥功能的单晶圆湿法清洗设备；或
text.en: p.2. Single wafer wet cleaning equipment with surface modification drying; or
p.3. [Reserved]

text.zh: p.4. 为使用超临界CO_{2}或升华干燥进行单晶圆清洗而设计的设备；
text.en: p.4. Equipment designed for single wafer cleaning using supercritical CO_{2} or sublimation drying;

text.zh: q. 为集成电路设计、未由3B001.g列明且具有3B001.j列明掩模“基板空白片”的“EUV”掩模和“EUV”光刻版；或
text.en: q. “EUV” masks and “EUV” reticles, designed for integrated circuits, not specified by 3B001.g, and having a mask “substrate blank” specified by 3B001.j; or

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 就3B001.q而言，装有防尘膜的掩模或光刻版仍视为掩模和光刻版。
text.en: For the purposes of 3B001.q, masks or reticles with a mounted pellicle are considered masks and reticles.

text.zh: r. 为EUV‘图形整形’而设计的设备。
text.en: r. Equipment designed for EUV 'pattern shaping.'

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3B001.r而言，‘图形整形’是指利用非垂直定向粒子，包括离子、中性粒子、团簇、自由基或光，对EUV光刻产生的图形进行重塑或修整，以改善整体图形形成效果的沉积或去除工艺。
text.en: For the purposes of 3B001.r, 'pattern shaping' is a deposition or removal process used to improve overall patterning by reshaping or trimming patterns produced using EUV lithography with non-vertical directed particles including ions, neutral particles, clusters, radicals, or light.

text.zh: 相关定义：‘溅射’是一种覆层涂覆工艺，其中带正电荷的离子在电场作用下加速朝向靶材（涂层材料）表面。撞击离子的动能足以使靶材表面的原子释放并沉积在衬底上。注释：用于提高涂层附着力和沉积速率的三极溅射、磁控溅射或射频溅射，均为该工艺的常规改型。
text.en: Related Definitions: 'Sputtering' is an overlay coating process wherein positively charged ions are accelerated by an electric field towards the surface of a target (coating material). The kinetic energy of the impacting ions is sufficient to cause target surface atoms to be released and deposited on the substrate. Note: Triode, magnetron or radio frequency sputtering to increase adhesion of coating and rate of deposition are ordinary modifications of the process.

text.zh: a. 为制造3A001或3A991管制的电子管、光学元件及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“组件”而“专门设计”的设备；
text.en: a. Equipment “specially designed” for the manufacture of electron tubes, optical elements, and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor controlled by 3A001 or 3A991;

text.zh: b. 为制造半导体器件、集成电路和“电子组件”而“专门设计”的下列设备，以及包含此类设备或具有其特性的系统：
text.en: b. Equipment “specially designed” for the manufacture of semiconductor devices, integrated circuits and “electronic assemblies,” as follows, and systems incorporating or having the characteristics of such equipment:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B991.b还管制用于或经改装用于制造其他器件（例如成像器件、电光器件、声波器件）的设备。
text.en: 3B991.b also controls equipment used or modified for use in the manufacture of other devices, such as imaging devices, electro-optical devices, acoustic-wave devices.

text.zh: b.1. 下列用于加工制造3B991.b标题所列器件、“零件”和“组件”所需材料的设备：
text.en: b.1. Equipment for the processing of materials for the manufacture of devices, “parts,” and “components” as specified in the heading of 3B991.b, as follows:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B991不管制为3B991.b.1管制加工设备“专门设计”的石英炉管、炉衬、桨片、舟（“专门设计”的笼式舟除外）、鼓泡器、晶圆盒或坩埚。
text.en: 3B991 does not control quartz furnace tubes, furnace liners, paddles, boats (except “specially designed” caged boats), bubblers, cassettes or crucibles “specially designed” for the processing equipment controlled by 3B991.b.1.

text.zh: b.1.a. 用于生产多晶硅及3C001管制材料的设备；
text.en: b.1.a. Equipment for producing polycrystalline silicon and materials controlled by 3C001;

text.zh: b.1.b. 为提纯或加工ECCN 3C001、3C002、3C003、3C004或3C005管制的III/V族和II/VI族半导体材料而“专门设计”的设备，但晶体提拉炉除外，晶体提拉炉见下文3B991.b.1.c；
text.en: b.1.b. Equipment “specially designed” for purifying or processing III/V and II/VI semiconductor materials controlled by ECCNs 3C001, 3C002, 3C003, 3C004, or 3C005 except crystal pullers, for which see 3B991.b.1.c below;

text.zh: b.1.c. 下列晶体提拉炉和炉：
text.en: b.1.c. Crystal pullers and furnaces, as follows:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B991.b.1.c不管制扩散炉和氧化炉。
text.en: 3B991.b.1.c does not control diffusion and oxidation furnaces.

text.zh: b.1.c.1. 采用高能量传递速率、能够以超过每分钟0.005 m^{2}的速率加工晶圆的退火或再结晶设备，但恒温炉除外；
text.en: b.1.c.1. Annealing or recrystallizing equipment other than constant temperature furnaces employing high rates of energy transfer capable of processing wafers at a rate exceeding 0.005 m^{2} per minute;

text.zh: b.1.c.2. 具有下列任一特性的“存储程序控制”晶体提拉炉：
text.en: b.1.c.2. “Stored program controlled” crystal pullers having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.1.c.2.a. 无需更换坩埚容器即可再次加料；
text.en: b.1.c.2.a. Rechargeable without replacing the crucible container;

text.zh: b.1.c.2.b. 能够在高于2.5 × 10^{5} Pa的压力下工作；或
text.en: b.1.c.2.b. Capable of operation at pressures above 2.5 × 10^{5} Pa; or

text.zh: b.1.c.2.c. 能够提拉直径超过100 mm的晶体；
text.en: b.1.c.2.c. Capable of pulling crystals of a diameter exceeding 100 mm;

text.zh: b.1.d. 具有下列任一特性的“存储程序控制”外延生长设备：
text.en: b.1.d. “Stored program controlled” equipment for epitaxial growth having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.1.d.1. 能够生产在大于等于200 mm的距离上厚度均匀性偏差小于±2.5%的硅层；
text.en: b.1.d.1. Capable of producing silicon layer with a thickness uniform to less than ±2.5% across a distance of 200 mm or more;

text.zh: b.1.d.2. 能够生产除硅以外任何材料的层，且其整个晶圆范围的厚度均匀性等于或优于±3.5%；或
text.en: b.1.d.2. Capable of producing a layer of any material other than silicon with a thickness uniformity across the wafer of equal to or better than ±3.5%; or

text.zh: b.1.d.3. 在加工过程中使各晶圆独立旋转；
text.en: b.1.d.3. Rotation of individual wafers during processing;

text.zh: b.1.e. 分子束外延生长设备；
text.en: b.1.e. Molecular beam epitaxial growth equipment;

text.zh: b.1.f. 具有“专门设计”的一体式装载锁室、能够在隔离真空环境中传送晶圆的磁增强‘溅射’设备；
text.en: b.1.f. Magnetically enhanced 'sputtering' equipment with “specially designed” integral load locks capable of transferring wafers in an isolated vacuum environment;

text.zh: b.1.g. 为离子注入、离子增强扩散或光增强扩散而“专门设计”，且具有下列任一特性的设备：
text.en: b.1.g. Equipment “specially designed” for ion implantation, ion-enhanced, or photo-enhanced diffusion, having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.1.g.1. 图形化能力；
text.en: b.1.g.1. Patterning capability;

text.zh: b.1.g.2. 束能量（加速电压）超过200 keV；
text.en: b.1.g.2. Beam energy (accelerating voltage) exceeding 200 keV;

text.zh: b.1.g.3 经优化可在小于10 keV的束能量（加速电压）下工作；或
text.en: b.1.g.3 Optimized to operate at a beam energy (accelerating voltage) of less than 10 keV; or

text.zh: b.1.g.4. 能够向加热的“衬底”进行高能氧注入；
text.en: b.1.g.4. Capable of high energy oxygen implant into a heated “substrate”;

text.zh: b.1.h. 下列采用各向异性干法（例如等离子体）进行选择性去除（即刻蚀）的“存储程序控制”设备：
text.en: b.1.h. “Stored program controlled” equipment for the selective removal (i.e., etching) by means of anisotropic dry methods (e.g., plasma), as follows:

text.zh: b.1.h.1. 具有下列任一特性的批量式设备：
text.en: b.1.h.1. Batch types having either of the following:

text.zh: b.1.h.1.a. 具有光发射光谱型以外的终点检测功能；或
text.en: b.1.h.1.a. End-point detection, other than optical emission spectroscopy types; or

text.zh: b.1.h.1.b. 反应器工作（刻蚀）压力小于等于26.66 Pa；
text.en: b.1.h.1.b. Reactor operational (etching) pressure of 26.66 Pa or less;

text.zh: b.1.h.2. 具有下列任一特性的单晶圆式设备：
text.en: b.1.h.2. Single wafer types having any of the following:

text.zh: b.1.h.2.a. 具有光发射光谱型以外的终点检测功能；
text.en: b.1.h.2.a. End-point detection, other than optical emission spectroscopy types;

text.zh: b.1.h.2.b. 反应器工作（刻蚀）压力小于等于26.66 Pa；或
text.en: b.1.h.2.b. Reactor operational (etching) pressure of 26.66 Pa or less; or

text.zh: b.1.h.2.c. 具有晶圆盒到晶圆盒传送和装载锁室晶圆搬运功能；
text.en: b.1.h.2.c. Cassette-to-cassette and load locks wafer handling;
Note 1:

text.zh: “批量式”是指并非为单晶圆生产加工而“专门设计”的机器。此类机器可使用共同工艺参数（例如射频功率、温度、刻蚀气体种类、流量）同时加工两片或更多晶圆。
text.en: “Batch types” refers to machines not “specially designed” for production processing of single wafers. Such machines can process two or more wafers simultaneously with common process parameters (e.g., RF power, temperature, etch gas species, flow rates).
Note 2:

text.zh: “单晶圆式”是指为单晶圆生产加工而“专门设计”的机器。这些机器可使用自动晶圆搬运技术将单片晶圆装入设备进行加工。该定义包括能够装载和加工多片晶圆，但可为每片晶圆独立确定刻蚀参数（例如射频功率或终点）的设备。
text.en: “Single wafer types” refers to machines “specially designed” for production processing of single wafers. These machines may use automatic wafer handling techniques to load a single wafer into the equipment for processing. The definition includes equipment that can load and process several wafers but where the etching parameters (e.g., RF power or end point) can be independently determined for each individual wafer.

text.zh: b.1.i. 用于半导体器件制造、沉积氧化物、氮化物、金属或多晶硅，且具有下列任一能力的“化学气相沉积”（CVD）设备（例如等离子体增强CVD（PECVD）或光增强CVD）：
text.en: b.1.i. “Chemical vapor deposition” (CVD) equipment (e.g., plasma-enhanced CVD (PECVD) or photo-enhanced CVD) for semiconductor device manufacturing, having either of the following capabilities, for deposition of oxides, nitrides, metals, or polysilicon:

text.zh: b.1.i.1. 在低于10^{5} Pa的压力下工作的“化学气相沉积”设备；或
text.en: b.1.i.1. “Chemical vapor deposition” equipment operating below 10^{5} Pa; or

text.zh: b.1.i.2. 在低于60 Pa（450毫托）的压力下工作，或具有自动晶圆盒到晶圆盒传送和装载锁室晶圆搬运功能的PECVD设备；
text.en: b.1.i.2. PECVD equipment operating either below 60 Pa (450 millitorr) or having automatic cassette-to-cassette and load lock wafer handling;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B991.b.1.i不管制低压“化学气相沉积”（LPCVD）系统或反应“溅射”设备。
text.en: 3B991.b.1.i does not control low pressure “chemical vapor deposition” (LPCVD) systems or reactive “sputtering” equipment.

text.zh: b.1.j. 为制造掩模或加工半导体器件而“专门设计”或改装，且具有下列任一特性的电子束系统：
text.en: b.1.j. Electron beam systems “specially designed” or modified for mask making or semiconductor device processing having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.1.j.1. 静电束偏转；
text.en: b.1.j.1. Electrostatic beam deflection;

text.zh: b.1.j.2. 经整形的非高斯束形；
text.en: b.1.j.2. Shaped, non-Gaussian beam profile;

text.zh: b.1.j.3. 数模转换速率超过3 MHz；
text.en: b.1.j.3. Digital-to-analog conversion rate exceeding 3 MHz;

text.zh: b.1.j.4. 数模转换精度超过12 bit；或
text.en: b.1.j.4. Digital-to-analog conversion accuracy exceeding 12 bit; or

text.zh: b.1.j.5. 靶相对于束的位置反馈控制精度为1微米或更精细；
text.en: b.1.j.5. Target-to-beam position feedback control precision of 1 micrometer or finer;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B991.b.1.j不管制电子束沉积系统或通用扫描电子显微镜。
text.en: 3B991.b.1.j does not control electron beam deposition systems or general purpose scanning electron microscopes.

text.zh: b.1.k. 下列用于半导体晶圆加工的表面精整设备：
text.en: b.1.k. Surface finishing equipment for the processing of semiconductor wafers as follows:

text.zh: b.1.k.1. 为对厚度小于100微米的晶圆进行背面加工及其后续分离而“专门设计”的设备；或
text.en: b.1.k.1. “Specially designed” equipment for backside processing of wafers thinner than 100 micrometer and the subsequent separation thereof; or

text.zh: b.1.k.2. 为使加工后晶圆有源表面的表面粗糙度达到双sigma值小于等于2微米的总指示读数（TIR）而“专门设计”的设备；
text.en: b.1.k.2. “Specially designed” equipment for achieving a surface roughness of the active surface of a processed wafer with a two-sigma value of 2 micrometer or less, total indicator reading (TIR);

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B991.b.1.k不管制用于晶圆表面精整的单面研磨和抛光设备。
text.en: 3B991.b.1.k does not control single-side lapping and polishing equipment for wafer surface finishing.

text.zh: b.1.l. 包含共用单个或多个真空腔室，为使3B991管制的任何设备可集成为完整系统而“专门设计”的互连设备；
text.en: b.1.l. Interconnection equipment which includes common single or multiple vacuum chambers “specially designed” to permit the integration of any equipment controlled by 3B991 into a complete system;

text.zh: b.1.m. 使用“激光器”修复或修调“单片集成电路”，且具有下列任一特性的“存储程序控制”设备：
text.en: b.1.m. “Stored program controlled” equipment using “lasers” for the repair or trimming of “monolithic integrated circuits” with either of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.1.m.1. 定位精度小于±1微米；或
text.en: b.1.m.1. Positioning accuracy less than ±1 micrometer; or

text.zh: b.1.m.2. 光斑尺寸（切缝宽度）小于3微米。
text.en: b.1.m.2. Spot size (kerf width) less than 3 micrometer.

text.zh: b.2. 下列用于制造3B991标题所列器件、“零件”和“组件”的掩模、掩模“衬底”、掩模制造设备和图像转移设备：
text.en: b.2. Masks, mask “substrates,” mask-making equipment and image transfer equipment for the manufacture of devices, “parts” and “components” as specified in the heading of 3B991, as follows:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: “掩模”一词是指用于电子束光刻、X射线光刻及紫外光刻，以及通常的紫外和可见光光刻的掩模。
text.en: The term “masks” refers to those used in electron beam lithography, X-ray lithography, and ultraviolet lithography, as well as the usual ultraviolet and visible photo-lithography.

text.zh: b.2.a. 成品掩模、光刻版及其设计，但以下除外：
text.en: b.2.a. Finished masks, reticles and designs therefor, except:

text.zh: b.2.a.1. 用于生产不受禁运限制的集成电路的成品掩模或光刻版；或
text.en: b.2.a.1. Finished masks or reticles for the production of unembargoed integrated circuits; or

text.zh: b.2.a.2. 同时具有以下两项特性的掩模或光刻版：
text.en: b.2.a.2. Masks or reticles, having both of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.2.a.2.a. 其设计基于大于等于2.5微米的几何尺寸；以及
text.en: b.2.a.2.a. Their design is based on geometries of 2.5 micrometer or more; and

text.zh: b.2.a.2.b. 设计中不含可通过生产设备或“软件”改变预期用途的特殊功能；
text.en: b.2.a.2.b. The design does not include special features to alter the intended use by means of production equipment or “software”;

text.zh: b.2.b. 下列掩模“衬底”：
text.en: b.2.b. Mask “substrates” as follows:

text.zh: b.2.b.1. 用于制备尺寸超过125 mm x 125 mm的掩模、涂覆硬质表面（例如铬、硅、钼）的“衬底”（例如玻璃、石英、蓝宝石）；或
text.en: b.2.b.1. Hard surface (e.g., chromium, silicon, molybdenum) coated “substrates” (e.g., glass, quartz, sapphire) for the preparation of masks having dimensions exceeding 125 mm x 125 mm; or

text.zh: b.2.b.2. 为X射线掩模“专门设计”的“衬底”；
text.en: b.2.b.2. “Substrates” “specially designed” for X-ray masks;

text.zh: b.2.c. 为半导体器件或集成电路的计算机辅助设计（CAD）而“专门设计”的设备，但通用计算机除外；
text.en: b.2.c. Equipment, other than general purpose computers, “specially designed” for computer aided design (CAD) of semiconductor devices or integrated circuits;

text.zh: b.2.d. 下列用于制造掩模或光刻版的设备或机器：
text.en: b.2.d. Equipment or machines, as follows, for mask or reticle fabrication:

text.zh: b.2.d.1. 能够产生大于100 mm x 100 mm的阵列，或能够在像面（即焦面）上产生大于6 mm x 6 mm的单次曝光，或能够在“衬底”上的光刻胶中产生小于2.5微米线宽的光学步进重复照相机；
text.en: b.2.d.1. Photo-optical step and repeat cameras capable of producing arrays larger than 100 mm x 100 mm, or capable of producing a single exposure larger than 6 mm x 6 mm in the image (i.e., focal) plane, or capable of producing line widths of less than 2.5 micrometer in the photoresist on the “substrate”;

text.zh: b.2.d.2. 采用离子束或“激光”束光刻，能够产生小于2.5微米线宽的掩模或光刻版制造设备；或
text.en: b.2.d.2. Mask or reticle fabrication equipment using ion or “laser” beam lithography capable of producing line widths of less than 2.5 micrometer; or

text.zh: b.2.d.3. 用于修改掩模或光刻版，或加装防尘膜以消除缺陷的设备或夹持器；
text.en: b.2.d.3. Equipment or holders for altering masks or reticles or adding pellicles to remove defects;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B991.b.2.d.1和b.2.d.2不管制采用光学方法、在1980年1月1日之前已商业供应，或性能不优于此类设备的掩模制造设备。
text.en: 3B991.b.2.d.1 and b.2.d.2 do not control mask fabrication equipment using photo-optical methods which was either commercially available before the 1st of January, 1980, or has a performance no better than such equipment.

text.zh: b.2.e. 用于检验掩模、光刻版或防尘膜，且具有以下特性的“存储程序控制”设备：
text.en: b.2.e. “Stored program controlled” equipment for the inspection of masks, reticles or pellicles with:

text.zh: b.2.e.1. 分辨率为0.25微米或更精细；以及
text.en: b.2.e.1. A resolution of 0.25 micrometer or finer; and

text.zh: b.2.e.2. 在一个或两个坐标方向上大于等于63.5 mm的距离范围内，精度为0.75微米或更精细；
text.en: b.2.e.2. A precision of 0.75 micrometer or finer over a distance in one or two coordinates of 63.5 mm or more;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B991.b.2.e不管制通用扫描电子显微镜，但为自动图形检验而“专门设计”且配有相应仪器的除外。
text.en: 3B991.b.2.e does not control general purpose scanning electron microscopes except when “specially designed” and instrumented for automatic pattern inspection.

text.zh: b.2.f. 采用光学或X射线方法进行晶圆生产的对准和曝光设备（例如光刻设备），包括投影图像转移设备以及步进重复式（即晶圆直接步进式）或步进扫描式（扫描器）设备，且能够执行下列任一功能：
text.en: b.2.f. Align and expose equipment for wafer production using photo-optical or X-ray methods (e.g., lithography equipment) including both projection image transfer equipment and step and repeat (i.e., direct step on wafer) or step and scan (scanner) equipment, capable of performing any of the following functions:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B991.b.2.f不管制光学接触式及接近式掩模对准和曝光设备，或接触式图像转移设备。
text.en: 3B991.b.2.f does not control photo-optical contact and proximity mask align and expose equipment or contact image transfer equipment.

text.zh: b.2.f.1. 生产尺寸小于2.5微米的图形；
text.en: b.2.f.1. Production of a pattern size of less than 2.5 micrometer;

text.zh: b.2.f.2. 对准精度优于±0.25微米（3 sigma）；
text.en: b.2.f.2. Alignment with a precision finer than ±0.25 micrometer (3 sigma);

text.zh: b.2.f.3. 机间套刻精度不优于±0.3微米；或
text.en: b.2.f.3. Machine-to-machine overlay no better than ±0.3 micrometer; or

text.zh: b.2.f.4. 光源波长短于400 nm；
text.en: b.2.f.4. A light source wavelength shorter than 400 nm;

text.zh: b.2.g. 能够产生小于2.5微米图形的电子束、离子束或X射线投影图像转移设备；
text.en: b.2.g. Electron beam, ion beam or X-ray equipment for projection image transfer capable of producing patterns less than 2.5 micrometer;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 聚焦偏转束系统（直写系统）见3B991.b.1.j或b.10。
text.en: For focused, deflected-beam systems(direct write systems), see 3B991.b.1.j or b.10.

text.zh: b.2.h. 使用“激光器”在晶圆上直写，且能够产生小于2.5微米图形的设备。
text.en: b.2.h. Equipment using “lasers” for direct write on wafers capable of producing patterns less than 2.5 micrometer.

text.zh: b.3. 下列集成电路装配设备：
text.en: b.3. Equipment for the assembly of integrated circuits, as follows:

text.zh: b.3.a. 具有以下全部特性的“存储程序控制”芯片贴装机：
text.en: b.3.a. “Stored program controlled” die bonders having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.3.a.1. 为“混合集成电路”而“专门设计”；
text.en: b.3.a.1. “Specially designed” for “hybrid integrated circuits”;

text.zh: b.3.a.2. X-Y工作台定位行程超过37.5 × 37.5 mm；以及
text.en: b.3.a.2. X-Y stage positioning travel exceeding 37.5 × 37.5 mm; and

text.zh: b.3.a.3. X-Y平面内的贴装精度优于±10微米；
text.en: b.3.a.3. Placement accuracy in the X-Y plane of finer than ±10 micrometer;

text.zh: b.3.b. 用于在单次操作中形成多点键合的“存储程序控制”设备（例如梁式引线键合机、芯片载体键合机、带式键合机）；
text.en: b.3.b. “Stored program controlled” equipment for producing multiple bonds in a single operation (e.g., beam lead bonders, chip carrier bonders, tape bonders);

text.zh: b.3.c. 为3A001管制的陶瓷微电路封装而“专门设计”的半自动或自动热盖封口机，其将盖局部加热至高于封装本体的温度，且处理能力大于等于每分钟一个封装。
text.en: b.3.c. Semi-automatic or automatic hot cap sealers, in which the cap is heated locally to a higher temperature than the body of the package, “specially designed” for ceramic microcircuit packages controlled by 3A001 and that have a throughput equal to or more than one package per minute.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B991.b.3不管制通用电阻式点焊机。
text.en: 3B991.b.3 does not control general purpose resistance type spot welders.

text.zh: b.4. 用于洁净室、能够提供每0.02832 m^{3}中尺寸为0.3微米或更小的颗粒数小于等于10个的空气环境的过滤器，以及相应过滤材料。
text.en: b.4. Filters for clean rooms capable of providing an air environment of 10 or less particles of 0.3 micrometer or smaller per 0.02832 m^{3} and filter materials therefor.

title.zh: 不受3B002、3B993或3B994管制，用于检验或测试电子“组件”和材料的设备（见管制物项清单），以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”、“组件”和“附件”。
title.en: Equipment not controlled by 3B002, 3B993, or 3B994, for the inspection or testing of electronic “components” and materials, (see List of Items Controlled) and “specially designed” “parts,” “components” and “accessories” therefor.

summary.zh: 不受3B002、3B993或3B994管制，用于检验或测试电子“组件”和材料的设备（见管制物项清单），以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”、“组件”和“附件”。
summary.en: Equipment not controlled by 3B002, 3B993, or 3B994, for the inspection or testing of electronic “components” and materials, (see List of Items Controlled) and “specially designed” “parts,” “components” and “accessories” therefor.

text.zh: 3B992 不受3B002、3B993或3B994管制，用于检验或测试电子“组件”和材料的设备（见管制物项清单），以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”、“组件”和“附件”。
text.en: 3B992 Equipment not controlled by 3B002, 3B993, or 3B994, for the inspection or testing of electronic “components” and materials, (see List of Items Controlled) and “specially designed” “parts,” “components” and “accessories” therefor.

text.en: LVS: N/A
