text.zh: 受管制物项清单
text.en: List of Items Controlled

text.zh: 相关管制：另见3A992.a。
text.en: Related Controls: See also 3A992.a.

text.zh: 相关定义：不适用
text.en: Related Definitions: N/A

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 为检验或测试3A001或3A991管制的电子管、光学元件及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“组件”而“专门设计”的设备；
text.en: a. Equipment “specially designed” for the inspection or testing of electron tubes, optical elements and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor controlled by 3A001 or 3A991;

text.zh: b. 为检验或测试半导体器件、集成电路和“电子组件”而“专门设计”的下列设备，以及包含此类设备或具有其特性的系统：
text.en: b. Equipment “specially designed” for the inspection or testing of semiconductor devices, integrated circuits and “electronic assemblies”, as follows, and systems incorporating or having the characteristics of such equipment:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B992.b还管制用于或经改装用于检验或测试其他器件（例如成像器件、电光器件、声波器件）的设备。
text.en: 3B992.b also controls equipment used or modified for use in the inspection or testing of other devices, such as imaging devices, electro-optical devices, acoustic-wave devices.

text.zh: b.1. 采用光学图像采集技术进行图形比较，自动检测加工后晶圆、“衬底”（印制电路板或芯片除外）内部或表面小于等于0.6微米的缺陷、错误或污染物的“存储程序控制”检验设备；
text.en: b.1. “Stored program controlled” inspection equipment for the automatic detection of defects, errors or contaminants of 0.6 micrometer or less in or on processed wafers, “substrates”, other than printed circuit boards or chips, using optical image acquisition techniques for pattern comparison;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B992.b.1不管制通用扫描电子显微镜，但为自动图形检验而“专门设计”且配有相应仪器的除外。
text.en: 3B992.b.1 does not control general purpose scanning electron microscopes, except when “specially designed” and instrumented for automatic pattern inspection.

text.zh: b.2. 下列“专门设计”的“存储程序控制”测量和分析设备：
text.en: b.2. “specially designed” “stored program controlled” measuring and analysis equipment, as follows:

text.zh: b.2.a. 为测量半导体材料中的氧（O）或碳（C）含量而“专门设计”；
text.en: b.2.a. “specially designed” for the measurement of oxygen (O) or carbon (C) content in semiconductor materials;

text.zh: b.2.b. 分辨率为1微米或更精细的线宽测量设备；
text.en: b.2.b. Equipment for line width measurement with a resolution of 1 micrometer or finer;

text.zh: b.2.c. 能够以1微米或更精细的分辨率测量小于等于10微米平面度偏差的“专门设计”平面度测量仪器。
text.en: b.2.c. “specially designed” flatness measurement instruments capable of measuring deviations from flatness of 10 micrometer or less with a resolution of 1 micrometer or finer.

text.zh: b.3. 具有下列任一特性的“存储程序控制”晶圆探针测试设备：
text.en: b.3. “Stored program controlled” wafer probing equipment having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.3.a. 定位精度优于3.5微米；
text.en: b.3.a. Positioning accuracy finer than 3.5 micrometer;

text.zh: b.3.b. 能够测试端子数超过68个的器件；或
text.en: b.3.b. Capable of testing devices having more than 68 terminals; or

text.zh: b.3.c. 能够在超过1 GHz的频率下测试；
text.en: b.3.c. Capable of testing at a frequency exceeding 1 GHz;

text.zh: b.4. 下列测试设备：
text.en: b.4. Test equipment as follows:

text.zh: b.4.a. 为测试分立半导体器件和未封装裸片而“专门设计”，且能够在超过18 GHz的频率下测试的“存储程序控制”设备；
text.en: b.4.a. “Stored program controlled” equipment “specially designed” for testing discrete semiconductor devices and unencapsulated dice, capable of testing at frequencies exceeding 18 GHz;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 分立半导体器件包括光电池和太阳能电池。
text.en: Discrete semiconductor devices include photocells and solar cells.

text.zh: b.4.b. 为测试集成电路及其“电子组件”而“专门设计”，且能够进行以下功能测试的“存储程序控制”设备：
text.en: b.4.b. “Stored program controlled” equipment “specially designed” for testing integrated circuits and “electronic assemblies” thereof, capable of functional testing:

text.zh: b.4.b.1. 在超过20 MHz的‘测试图形速率’下；或
text.en: b.4.b.1. At a 'pattern rate' exceeding 20 MHz; or

text.zh: b.4.b.2. 在超过10 MHz但不超过20 MHz的‘测试图形速率’下，且能够测试端子数超过68个的封装。
text.en: b.4.b.2. At a 'pattern rate' exceeding 10 MHz but not exceeding 20 MHz and capable of testing packages of more than 68 terminals.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B992.b.4.b不管制为测试下列物项而“专门设计”的测试设备：
text.en: 3B992.b.4.b does not control test equipment “specially designed” for testing:

text.zh: 1. 存储器；
text.en: 1. memories;

text.zh: 2. 用于家庭和娱乐用途的“组件”或某一类“电子组件”；以及
text.en: 2. “Assemblies” or a class of “electronic assemblies” for home and entertainment applications; and

text.zh: 3. 不受3A001或3A991管制的电子“零件”、“组件”、“装配件”和集成电路，前提是此类测试设备不包含具有“用户可访问的可编程性”的计算设施。
text.en: 3. Electronic “parts,” “components,” “assemblies” and integrated circuits not controlled by 3A001 or 3A991 provided such test equipment does not incorporate computing facilities with “user accessible programmability.”

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3B992.b.4.b而言，‘测试图形速率’定义为测试仪数字操作的最高频率。因此，其等于测试仪在非复用模式下能够提供的最高数据速率。其也称测试速度、最高数字频率或最高数字速度。
text.en: For purposes of 3B992.b.4.b, 'pattern rate' is defined as the maximum frequency of digital operation of a tester. It is therefore equivalent to the highest data rate that a tester can provide in non-multiplexed mode. It is also referred to as test speed, maximum digital frequency or maximum digital speed.

text.zh: b.4.c. 为确定焦平面阵列在大于1,200 nm波长下的性能而“专门设计”，采用“存储程序控制”测量或计算机辅助评估，且具有下列任一特性的设备：
text.en: b.4.c. Equipment “specially designed” for determining the performance of focal-plane arrays at wavelengths of more than 1,200 nm, using “stored program controlled” measurements or computer aided evaluation and having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.4.c.1. 使用直径小于0.12 mm的扫描光斑；
text.en: b.4.c.1. Using scanning light spot diameters of less than 0.12 mm;

text.zh: b.4.c.2. 为测量感光性能参数，并评估频率响应、调制传递函数、响应度均匀性或噪声而设计；或
text.en: b.4.c.2. Designed for measuring photosensitive performance parameters and for evaluating frequency response, modulation transfer function, uniformity of responsivity or noise; or

text.zh: b.4.c.3. 为评估能够生成超过32 × 32线元图像的阵列而设计；
text.en: b.4.c.3. Designed for evaluating arrays capable of creating images with more than 32 × 32 line elements;

text.zh: b.5. 为在小于等于3 keV下工作而设计的电子束测试系统，或“激光”束系统，用于对通电半导体器件进行非接触探测，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: b.5. Electron beam test systems designed for operation at 3 keV or below, or “laser” beam systems, for non-contactive probing of powered-up semiconductor devices having any of the following:

text.zh: b.5.a. 具有采用束消隐或探测器选通的频闪能力；
text.en: b.5.a. Stroboscopic capability with either beam blanking or detector strobing;

text.zh: b.5.b. 具有用于电压测量、分辨率小于0.5 V的电子能谱仪；或
text.en: b.5.b. An electron spectrometer for voltage measurements with a resolution of less than 0.5 V; or

text.zh: b.5.c. 具有用于集成电路性能分析的电气测试夹具；
text.en: b.5.c. Electrical tests fixtures for performance analysis of integrated circuits;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B992.b.5不管制扫描电子显微镜，但为对通电半导体器件进行非接触探测而“专门设计”且配有相应仪器的除外。
text.en: 3B992.b.5 does not control scanning electron microscopes, except when “specially designed” and instrumented for non-contactive probing of a powered-up semiconductor device.

text.zh: b.6. 为掩模或半导体器件的制造、修复、物理布局分析和测试而“专门设计”，且具有下列任一特性的“存储程序控制”多功能聚焦离子束系统：
text.en: b.6. “Stored program controlled” multifunctional focused ion beam systems “specially designed” for manufacturing, repairing, physical layout analysis and testing of masks or semiconductor devices and having either of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.6.a. 靶相对于束的位置反馈控制精度为1微米或更精细；或
text.en: b.6.a. Target-to-beam position feedback control precision of 1 micrometer or finer; or

text.zh: b.6.b. 数模转换精度超过12 bit；
text.en: b.6.b. Digital-to-analog conversion accuracy exceeding 12 bit;

text.zh: b.7. 采用“激光器”、为测量空气中颗粒尺寸和浓度而设计，且同时具有以下两项特性的颗粒测量系统：
text.en: b.7. Particle measuring systems employing “lasers” designed for measuring particle size and concentration in air having both of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.7.a. 能够在大于等于每分钟0.02832 m^{3}的流量下，测量小于等于0.2微米的颗粒尺寸；以及
text.en: b.7.a. Capable of measuring particle sizes of 0.2 micrometer or less at a flow rate of 0.02832 m^{3} per minute or more; and

text.zh: b.7.b. 能够表征10级或更高洁净度的空气。
text.en: b.7.b. Capable of characterizing Class 10 clean air or better.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. [保留]
text.en: a. [Reserved]

text.zh: b. 用于300 mm晶圆、为离子注入而设计，且具有下列任一特性的半导体晶圆制造设备：
text.en: b. Semiconductor wafer fabrication equipment for 300 mm wafers designed for ion implantation and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 为等离子体掺杂而设计，且具有以下全部特性的设备：
text.en: b.1. Equipment designed for plasma doping, having all of the following:

text.zh: b.1.a. 一个或多个射频（RF）功率源；
text.en: b.1.a. One or more Radio Frequency (RF) power source(s);

text.zh: b.1.b. 一个或多个脉冲直流电源；以及
text.en: b.1.b. One or more pulsed DC Power Source; and

text.zh: b.1.c. 一种或多种n型或p型掺杂剂注入。
text.en: b.1.c. One or more n-type or p-type dopant implants.

text.zh: b.2［保留］
text.en: b.2 [Reserved]

text.zh: c. 下列刻蚀设备：
text.en: c. Etch equipment as follows:

text.zh: c.1. 为介电材料的各向异性刻蚀而设计或改装，能够制造深宽比大于30:1且顶面横向尺寸小于100 nm的高深宽比结构，且具有以下全部特性的设备：
text.en: c.1. Equipment designed or modified for anisotropic etching of dielectric materials and enabling the fabrication of high aspect ratio features with aspect ratio greater than 30:1 and a lateral dimension on the top surface of less than 100 nm, and having all of the following:

text.zh: c.1.a. 射频（RF）功率源，具有至少一个脉冲射频输出；以及
text.en: c.1.a. Radio Frequency (RF) power source(s) with at least one pulsed RF output; and

text.zh: c.1.b. 一个或多个切换时间小于300毫秒的快速气体切换阀。
text.en: c.1.b. One or more fast gas switching valve(s) with switching time less than 300 milliseconds.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B993.c.1包括通过‘自由基’、离子、顺序反应或非顺序反应进行的刻蚀。
text.en: 3B993.c.1 includes etching by 'radicals', ions, sequential reactions, or non-sequential reaction.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3B993.c.1注释而言，‘自由基’定义为在开放电子壳层构型中具有未成对电子的原子、分子或离子。
text.en: For the purposes of the Note to 3B993.c.1, 'radical' is defined as an atom, molecule, or ion that has an unpaired electron in an open electron shell configuration.

text.zh: c.2. 未由3B993.c.1列明，为介电材料的各向异性刻蚀而设计，且能够制造具有以下全部特性的高深宽比结构的设备：
text.en: c.2. Equipment, not specified by 3B993.c.1, designed for anisotropic etching of dielectric material and enabling the fabrication of high aspect ratio features having all of the following:

text.zh: c.2.a. 深宽比大于30:1；以及
text.en: c.2.a. An aspect ratio greater than 30:1; and

text.zh: c.2.b. 顶面横向尺寸小于40 nm。
text.en: c.2.b. A lateral dimension on the top surface of less than 40 nm.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3B993.c.2不适用于为直径小于300 mm的晶圆而设计的设备。
text.en: 3B993.c.2 does not apply to equipment designed for wafer diameters less than 300 mm.

text.zh: c.3. 未由3B001.c.1.c列明，为各向异性干法刻蚀而设计或改装，且具有以下全部特性的设备：
text.en: c.3. Equipment, not specified by 3B001.c.1.c, designed or modified for anisotropic dry etching, having all of the following:

text.zh: c.3.a. 射频（RF）功率源，具有至少一个脉冲射频输出；
text.en: c.3.a. Radio Frequency (RF) power source(s) with at least one pulsed RF output;

text.zh: c.3.b. 一个或多个切换时间小于500毫秒的快速气体切换阀；以及
text.en: c.3.b. One or more fast gas switching valve(s) with switching time less than 500 milliseconds; and

text.zh: c.3.c. 具有大于等于10个可独立控制变温元件的静电卡盘。
text.en: c.3.c. Electrostatic chuck with greater than or equal to 10 individually controllable variable temperature elements.

text.zh: d. 下列半导体制造沉积设备：
text.en: d. Semiconductor manufacturing deposition equipment as follows:

text.zh: d.1. 未由3B001.d.14列明，为借助远程生成的‘自由基’进行沉积而设计、能够制造含硅（Si）和碳（C）薄膜，且沉积薄膜具有以下全部特性的设备：
text.en: d.1. Equipment designed, not specified by 3B001.d.14, for deposition assisted by remotely generated 'radicals', enabling the fabrication of a silicon (Si) and carbon (C) containing film, and having all of the following properties of the deposited film:

text.zh: d.1.a. 介电常数（k）小于5.3；
text.en: d.1.a. A dielectric constant (k) of less than 5.3;

text.zh: d.1.b. 位于深宽比大于5:1且横向开口小于70 nm的结构中；以及
text.en: d.1.b. In features with an aspect ratio greater than 5:1 with lateral openings of less than 70 nm; and

text.zh: d.1.c. 结构间节距小于100 nm。
text.en: d.1.c. A feature-to-feature pitch of less than 100 nm.

text.zh: d.2. 为在宽度小于70 nm、深宽比大于5:1（深度:宽度）且结构间节距小于100 nm的横向开口中沉积含硅和碳、介电常数（k）小于5.3的薄膜，同时将晶圆衬底温度维持在大于400 °C且小于650 °C而设计，且具有以下全部特性的设备：
text.en: d.2. Equipment designed for deposition of a film, containing silicon and carbon, and having a dielectric constant (k) of less than 5.3, into lateral openings having widths of less than 70 nm and aspect ratios greater than 5:1 (depth: width) and a feature-to-feature pitch of less than 100 nm, while maintaining the wafer substrate at a temperature greater than 400 °C and less than 650 °C, and having all of the following:

text.zh: d.2.a. 为容纳多片垂直堆叠晶圆而设计的舟；
text.en: d.2.a. Boat designed to hold multiple vertically stacked wafers;

text.zh: d.2.b. 两个或更多垂直喷射器；以及
text.en: d.2.b. Two or more vertical injectors; and

text.zh: d.2.c. 硅源和丙烯被引入的喷射器，与氮源或氧源被引入的喷射器不同。
text.en: d.2.c. A silicon source and propene are introduced to a different injector than a nitrogen source or an oxygen source.

text.zh: d.3. 为通过化学气相沉积形成密度大于1.6 g/cm^{3}的碳材料层而设计的设备。
text.en: d.3. Equipment designed for chemical vapor deposition of a carbon material layer with a density more than 1.6 g/cm^{3}.

text.zh: d.4. 未由3B001.d.19列明、具有两种以上金属前体直接液体注入功能，为在单个沉积腔室内的深宽比大于50:1的结构中沉积介电常数（K）大于35的共形介电薄膜而设计或改装的沉积设备。
text.en: d.4. Deposition equipment, not specified by 3B001.d.19, having direct-liquid injection of more than two metal precursors, designed or modified to deposit a conformal dielectric film with a dielectric constant (K) greater than 35 in features with aspect ratio greater than 50:1 in a single deposition chamber.

text.zh: e. [保留]
text.en: e. [Reserved]

text.zh: f. 下列光刻商品：
text.en: f. Lithography commodities as follows:

text.zh: f.1. 采用光学或X射线方法进行晶圆加工，且具有以下全部特性的步进重复式（晶圆直接步进式）或步进扫描式（扫描器）对准和曝光光刻设备：
text.en: f.1. Align and expose step and repeat (direct step on wafer) or step and scan (scanner) lithography equipment for wafer processing using photo-optical or X-ray methods and having all of the following:

text.zh: f.1.a.［保留］
text.en: f.1.a. [Reserved]

text.zh: f.1.b. 光源波长大于等于193 nm，且具有以下全部特性：
text.en: f.1.b. A light source wavelength equal to or longer than 193 nm and having all of the following:

text.zh: f.1.b.1 能够产生‘最小可分辨特征尺寸’（‘MRF’）小于等于45 nm的图形；以及
text.en: f.1.b.1 The capability to produce a pattern with a 'Minimum Resolvable Feature size' ('MRF') of 45 nm or less; and

text.zh: f.1.b.2. 最大‘专用卡盘套刻’值大于1.50 nm且小于等于2.40 nm。
text.en: f.1.b.2. A maximum 'dedicated chuck overlay' value greater than 1.50 nm and less than or equal to 2.40 nm.

text.zh: 3B993.f.1款技术说明：
text.en: Technical Notes for paragraph 3B993.f.1:

text.zh: 1. ‘最小可分辨特征尺寸’（‘MRF’）按下式计算：
text.en: 1. The 'Minimum Resolvable Feature size' ('MRF') is calculated by the following formula:

text.zh: [公式图片：https://img.federalregister.gov/ER16JA25.004/ER16JA25.004_large.png]
text.en: [FORMULA IMAGE: https://img.federalregister.gov/ER16JA25.004/ER16JA25.004_large.png]

text.zh: 其中，就3B993.f.1而言，K因子=0.25。
text.en: where, for the purposes of 3B993.f.1, the K factor = 0.25.

text.zh: ‘MRF’也称分辨率。
text.en: 'MRF' is also known as resolution.

text.zh: 2. ‘专用卡盘套刻’是指新图形与同一光刻系统已在晶圆上印制图形之间的对准精度。‘专用卡盘套刻’也称单机套刻。
text.en: 2. 'Dedicated chuck overlay' is the alignment accuracy of a new pattern to an existing pattern printed on a wafer by the same lithographic system. 'Dedicated chuck overlay' is also known as single machine overlay.

text.zh: f.2. 套刻精度大于1.5 nm，且小于（优于）或等于4.0 nm的压印光刻设备。
text.en: f.2. Imprint lithography equipment having an overlay accuracy above 1.5 nm and less (better) than or equal to 4.0 nm.

text.zh: f.3. 为使3B001.f.1或3B993.f.1列明设备在任意时间间隔内平均每小时加工晶圆数量提高超过1%而设计或改装的商品。
text.en: f.3. Commodities designed or modified to increase the number of wafers processed per hour, averaged over any time interval, by greater than 1%, of equipment specified in 3B001.f.1 or 3B993.f.1.

text.zh: f.4. 未由3B993.f.1列明，为在深紫外浸没式光刻设备中或与其配合执行以下全部功能而设计或改装的商品：
text.en: f.4. Commodities not specified by 3B993.f.1 designed or modified to perform all of the following in or with deep-ultraviolet immersion photolithography equipment:

text.zh: f.4.a. 降低3B993.f.1.b.1列明的最小可分辨特征尺寸；以及
text.en: f.4.a. Decrease the minimum resolvable feature specified by 3B993.f.1.b.1; and

text.zh: f.4.b. 将深紫外浸没式光刻设备的最大‘专用卡盘套刻’降低至大于1.5 nm且小于等于2.4 nm。
text.en: f.4.b. Decrease the maximum 'dedicated chuck overlay' of deep-ultraviolet immersion lithography equipment above 1.5 nm and below or equal to 2.4 nm.

text.zh: g.至n.［保留］
text.en: g. through n. [Reserved]

text.zh: o. 下列为300 mm晶圆而设计的退火设备：
text.en: o. Annealing equipment designed for 300 mm wafers as follows:

text.zh: o.1 在真空（小于等于0.01 Pa）环境中工作，并执行下列任一功能的退火设备：
text.en: o.1 Annealing equipment, operating in a vacuum (equal to or less than 0.01 Pa) environment, performing any of the following:

text.zh: o.1.a 铜（Cu）回流，以尽量减少或消除铜（Cu）金属互连中的空隙或接缝；或
text.en: o.1.a Reflow of copper (Cu) to minimize or eliminate voids or seams in copper (Cu) metal interconnects; or

text.zh: o.1.b 钴（Co）或钨（W）填充金属回流，以尽量减少或消除空隙或接缝；
text.en: o.1.b Reflow of cobalt (Co) or tungsten (W) fill metal to minimize or eliminate voids or seams;

text.zh: o.2. 为将半导体晶圆加热至高于1000 °C（1832 °F）的温度，且‘持续时间’小于2 ms而设计的设备。
text.en: o.2. Equipment designed to heat a semiconductor wafer to a temperature greater than 1000 °C (1832 °F) for a 'duration' less than 2 ms.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3B993.o.2而言，‘持续时间’是指高于所述温度的时间。
text.en: For the purposes of 3B993.o.2, 'duration' is the period above stated temperature.

text.zh: p. 下列去除和清洗设备：
text.en: p. Removal and cleaning equipment as follows:

text.zh: p.1. 为去除聚合物残留物和氧化铜（CuO）膜，并能够在真空（小于等于0.01 Pa）环境中沉积金属铜（Cu）而设计的设备。
text.en: p.1. Equipment designed for removing polymeric residue and copper oxide (CuO) film and enabling deposition of copper (Cu) metal in a vacuum (equal to or less than 0.01 Pa) environment.
p.2. [Reserved]

text.zh: p.3. 为干法表面氧化物去除预清洗或干法表面去污而设计的设备。
text.en: p.3. Equipment designed for dry surface oxide removal preclean or dry surface decontamination.
Note to 3B993.p.1 and p.3:

text.zh: 这些管制不适用于沉积设备。
text.en: These controls do not apply to deposition equipment.

text.zh: q. 下列检验和计量设备：
text.en: q. Inspection and metrology equipment as follows:

text.zh: q.1. 为接纳直径大于等于300 mm的晶圆而设计或改装，且具有以下全部特性的图形化晶圆缺陷计量或图形化晶圆缺陷检验设备：
text.en: q.1. Patterned wafer defect metrology or patterned wafer defect inspection equipment, designed or modified to accept wafers greater than or equal to 300 mm in diameter, and having all of the following:

text.zh: q.1.a. 为检测尺寸小于等于21 nm的缺陷而设计或改装；以及
text.en: q.1.a. Designed or modified to detect defects having a size equal to or less than 21 nm; and

text.zh: q.1.b. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: q.1.b. Having any of the following:

text.zh: q.1.b.1. 光学波长小于400 nm的光源；
text.en: q.1.b.1. A light source with an optical wavelength less than 400 nm;

text.zh: q.1.b.2. 分辨率小于（优于）或等于1.65 nm的电子束源；
text.en: q.1.b.2. An electron-beam source with a resolution less (better) than or equal to 1.65 nm;

text.zh: q.1.b.3. 冷场发射（CFE）电子束源；或
text.en: q.1.b.3. A Cold Field Emission (CFE) electron-beam source; or

text.zh: q.1.b.4. 两个或更多电子束源。
text.en: q.1.b.4. Two or more electron-beam sources.

text.zh: q.2. 下列计量设备：
text.en: q.2. Metrology equipment as follows:

text.zh: q.2.a. 为在光刻曝光前测量晶圆形状参数，并利用测量结果改善具有数值孔径大于1.3的浸没式透镜的深紫外（DUV）光刻系统或极紫外（EUV）光刻系统的套刻或聚焦而设计的独立设备；或
text.en: q.2.a. Stand-alone equipment designed to measure wafer shape parameters prior to lithography exposure and utilize measurements to improve overlay or focus of a deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography system having an immersion lens having a numerical aperture more than 1.3 or an Extreme Ultraviolet lithography (EUV) system; or

text.zh: q.2.b. 为在产品晶圆的光刻胶显影后或刻蚀后，使用基于图像的套刻或基于衍射的测量技术测量聚焦或套刻而设计，套刻测量精度小于（优于）或等于0.5 nm，且具有下列任一特性的计量设备：
text.en: q.2.b. Metrology equipment designed to measure focus or overlay after resist development or after etch on product wafers using image-based overlay or diffraction-based measurements techniques, with an overlay measurement accuracy less (better) than or equal to 0.5 nm having any of the following:

text.zh: q.2.b.1 为集成到‘涂胶显影轨道设备’而设计；或
text.en: q.2.b.1 designed for integration to a 'track'; or

text.zh: q.2.b.2 具有‘快速波长切换功能’；
text.en: q.2.b.2 'fast wavelength switching functionality';

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就3B993.q.2而言，‘涂胶显影轨道设备’是指为涂覆和显影专为光刻配制的光刻胶而设计的设备。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 3B993.q.2, a 'track' is equipment designed for coating and developing photoresist formulated for lithography.

text.zh: 2. 就3B993.q.2而言，‘快速波长切换功能’定义为能够在小于25 ms的时间内改变测量波长并获取一次测量结果。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 3B993.q.2, 'fast wavelength switching functionality' is defined as having the ability the change the measurement wavelength and acquire a measurement in less than 25 ms.

text.en: a. Silicon Carbide (SiC), Gallium Nitride (GaN), Aluminum Nitride (AlN), Aluminum Gallium Nitride (AlGaN), Gallium Oxide (Ga_{2}O_{3}), or diamond semiconductor “substrates”, or ingots, boules, or other preforms of those materials, having resistivities greater than 10,000 ohm-cm at 20 °C;

text.zh: b. 在20 °C时电阻率大于10,000 ohm-cm，且“衬底”表面具有至少一层硅（Si）、碳化硅（SiC）、氮化镓（GaN）、氮化铝（AlN）、氮化铝镓（AlGaN）、氧化镓（Ga_{2}O_{3}）或金刚石非外延单晶层的多晶“衬底”或多晶陶瓷“衬底”。
text.en: b. Polycrystalline “substrates” or polycrystalline ceramic “substrates”, having resistivities greater than 10,000 ohm-cm at 20 °C and having at least one non-epitaxial single-crystal layer of Silicon (Si), Silicon Carbide (SiC), Gallium Nitride (GaN), Aluminum Nitride (AlN), Aluminum Gallium Nitride (AlGaN), Gallium Oxide (Ga_{2}O_{3}), or diamond on the surface of the “substrate”.

text.zh: a. 为实现“寄存器传输级”（“RTL”）到“几何数据库标准II”（“GDSII”）或同等标准的转换而“专门设计”；或
text.en: a. “Specially designed” for implementing 'Register Transfer Level' ('RTL') to 'Geometrical Database Standard II' ('GDSII') or equivalent standard; or

text.zh: b. 为优化功耗或时序规则而“专门设计”。
text.en: b. “Specially designed” for optimization of power or timing rules.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 就3D006而言：
text.en: For the purposes of 3D006:

text.zh: 1. “电子计算机辅助设计”（“ECAD”）是一类用于设计、分析、优化和验证集成电路或印制电路板性能的“软件”工具。
text.en: 1. 'Electronic Computer-Aided Design' ('ECAD') is a category of “software” tools used for designing, analyzing, optimizing, and validating the performance of an integrated circuit or printed circuit board.

text.zh: 2. “寄存器传输级”（“RTL”）是一种设计抽象方法，通过硬件寄存器之间数字信号的流动以及对这些信号执行的逻辑运算，对同步数字电路建模。
text.en: 2. 'Register Transfer Level' ('RTL') is a design abstraction which models a synchronous digital circuit in terms of the flow of digital signals between hardware registers and the logical operations performed on those signals.

text.zh: 3. “几何数据库标准II”（“GDSII”）是一种用于交换集成电路或集成电路版图数据的数据库文件格式。
text.en: 3. 'Geometrical Database Standard II' ('GDSII') is a database file format for data exchange of integrated circuit or integrated circuit layout artwork.

text.en: See § 744.17 of the EAR for additional license requirements for microprocessors having a processing speed of 5 GFLOPS or more and an arithmetic logic unit with an access width of 32 bit or more, including those incorporating “information security” functionality, and associated “software” and “technology” for the “production” or “development” of such microprocessors.
